Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim, Approbat: Hasekamat
Harav hechasid hamefuresam, ish elohi, kadosh yeamer lo, morenu verabbenu harav rabbi meshulam zusil meanippali:

Hinne biroti et hakketavim shel harav hay gaon ish elokim kadosh vetahor aspaklarya hammeira, vetov asher asa vaasher hifli Adonai chasdo venatan belibbo hattahor laasot et kol elle lehareot am Adonai derachav hakkedoshim.

Uretzono haya shello lehaalot et hakketavim hahem levet haddefus mechamat sheen darko bechach. rak mechamat hitpashshetut hakkunetresim hahem bekerev kol yisrael behaetakot rabbot mide sofrim meshunnim, umechamat ribbuy haetakot shonot, rabbu hattauyyot-sofrim bimod. vehucherach lehavi hakkunetresim hahem levet haddefus.

Veheir Adonai et ruach hashshuttafim, hare hu harabbani hammufelag havvatik morenu verabbenu harav rabbi shalom shachna ben morenu harav verabbenu rabbi noach, vahare hu harabbani hammufelag havvatik morenu harav verabbenu rabbi mardechay ben morenu harav verabbenu rabbi shemuel hallevi, lehavi hakkunetresim hahem levet haddefus bislavivyta. ulefaala tava amarti yishar chela.

Ach alu belibbam magor missaviv min haddefusim asher rabbu, sheddarkan lehazzik ulekalkel hameushsharim. e lazot, gamarnu belibbenu litten hasekama, leval yarim ish et yado veet raglo ligrom lehammadpisim hannizkarim leel shum hezzek chas veshalom behassagat gevul beshum ofen.
Veasur leshum adam lidpos hassefer hannizkar leel bilti yediat hammadpisim hannizkarim leel, ad meshech chamesh shanim retzufim miyyom dilmatta. veshomea lidvaray elle – yavo alav birkat tov.
Halo ko divre haddoresh zot lichvod hattora, hayyom yom 3 shennichpal bo "ki tov", parasha tavo, shenat pedutenu lifrat katan.
Hakkatan meshulam zusil meanippali.
Hasekamat
Harav hechasid hamefuresam, ish elohi, kadosh yeamer lo, morenu harav verabbenu rabbi yehuda lebb hakkohen:

Chachmat adam tair pene haaretz, biroti yede kodesh hamechabber harav haggaon ish elokim kadosh vetahor chasid veanav, asher mikkevar nigla mistarav, yoshev bashshevet tachkemoni etzel adonenu morenu verabbenu geon olam, vedala mayim mibbeer mayim chayyim, vechaet yismach yisrael behiggalot divre kadsho hammechubbar lehavi levet haddefus lelammed leam Adonai darche kodesh, kaasher kol echad yecheze bifnimiyyut devarav.

Vehamefuresam en tzarich reaya. rak mechashash kilkul haddavar shello yigrom hezzek lammadpisim, bati litten tokef veazhara leval yarim ish et yado veraglo lidfos ad meshech chamesh shanim miyyom dilmatta. veshomea lidvaray elle – yavo alav birkat tov.
Halo ko divre hamedabber zot lichvod hattora, hayyom yom 3 parasha tavo 556 lifrat katan.
Yehuda lebb hakkohen.
Hasekamat
Harabbanim sheyyichyu bene haggaon hamechabber zichrono livracha nishmato eden.

Heyot shehusekam etzlenu litten reshut veharemana lehaalot al machbesh haddefus, lezikkaron livne yisrael, katuv divre yosher veemet, divre elokim chayyim shel adonenu avinu morenu verabbenu zichrono livracha, ketuvim bichtav yado hakkedosha beatzmo uleshono hakkadosh, shekkol devarav kegachale esh boarot, yalhivu hallevavot lekarvan laavihen shebbashshamayim, uveshem iggeret hakkodesh nikreu, sherubbam hayu iggeret shaluach meet kevod kedushshato lehorot leam Adonai hadderech yelchu vah vehammaase asher yaasun.

Umechamat shebbechamma mekomot hitztziv lo tziyyunim besefer "likkute amarim" shello, vedivre tora aniyyim bemakom echad vaashirim bemakom acher, uma gam bishvil davar shennitchaddesh bo – "kunetres acharon" al eze perakim, asher katav beet chibbero hassefer "likkute amarim" – pilpul veiyyun amok al maamre zohar veetz chayyim uferi etz chayyim shennirim kesotrim ze et ze, uveruach mibbinato meyashshevam kol dibbur al ofnav shekkatav belikkute amarim", rao rainu, sherauy venachon lechabberam im sefer "likkute amarim" veiggeret hatteshuva" shel kevod kedushshat adonenu avinu morenu verabbenu zichrono livracha.
E lazot, banu lehatil guda rabba ugezerat nidduy-cherem-shamta derabbanan delet lah asvavta, shello yarim ish et yado lehadepis ketavnitam o ze belo ze meshech chamishsha shanim miyyom dilmatta.

Beram, kegon da tzarich leodoe, shebbaavonotenu harabbim, safu tammu kitve yado hakkedosha beatzmo asher hayu bedikduk gadol lo chaser velo yater ot achat, velo nishar, ki im ze hameat meharebe asher nilketu echad leechad mehaetakot hamefuzzarim etzel hattalmidim, veim himmatze timmatze eze taut, "shegiot mi yavin?", yimmatze hattaut demuchach mittaut sofer, vehakkavvavna tihye berura:
Hayom, yom Adonai 22 iyyayr 574 lifrat katan.
Neum dov ber ben adoni avi mori verabbi haggaon hechasid kedosh yisrael marana verabbana sheneor zalman zichrono livracha, nishmato beginze meromim.
Uneum chayyim avraham ben adoni avi mori verabbi haggaon hechasid marana verabbana sheneor zalman zecher tzaddik livracha, nishmato beginze meromim.
Uneum moshe ben adoni avi mori verabbi haggaon hechasid sheneor zalman zichrono livracha, nishmato beginze meromim.
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim, Compiler: Vehi iggeret hashshelucha lichlalut anshe shelomenu, yevarchem tzurenu veyishmerem:

Alechem ishim ekra, shimu elay rodfe tzedek mevakshe Adonai, veyishma alechem elokim lemiggadol vead katan, kol anshe shelomenu dimdinatenu vesamochot shellah, ish al mekomo yavo leshalom vechayyim ad haolam netzach sela vaed, amen ken yehi ratzon:

Hinne mudaat zot, ki margela befume deinshe bechol anshe shelomenu lemor ki enah doma shemiat divre musar liriyyay ukeria bassefarim, shehakkore, kore lefi darko vedato ulefi hassagat utefisat sichlo baasher hu sham, veim sichlo vedato mevulebalim uvachashecha yithallachu baavodat Adonai, bekoshi yachol lirot et haor ki tov hagganuz bassefarim, af ki matok haor laenayim umarpe lanefesh.

Uvar min den, hinne sifre hayyira habbenuyim al pi sechel enoshi, bevavday enan shavin lechol nefesh, ki en kol hassechalim vehaddeot shavot, veen sechel adam ze mitpael umitorer mimma shemmitpael umitorer sechel chavero, uchemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha gabbe birkat chacham harazim al shishshim ribbo miyyisrael, "sheen deotehem domot zo lazo" vechulei, uchemo shekkatav haramban zichrono livracha bemilchamot sham beferush hassifre gabbe yehoshua shenneemar bo "ish asher ruach bo", sheyyachol lahaloch neged rucho shel kol echad veechad vechulei.

Ella afilu besifre hayyira asher yesodotam beharere kodesh, midreshe chachamenu-zichronam-livracha asher ruach Adonai dibber bam umillato al leshonam veorayyta vekudesha berich hu kolla chad, vechol shishshim ribbo neshamot kelalut yisrael, uferatehem uferate feratehem ad nitzotz kal shebbekallim ufechute haerech shebbeammenu bene yisrael – kullehu mitkashsheran beorayyta, veorayyta – hi hamekashsheret otan lehakkadosh-baruch-hu kannoda bazzohar hakkadosh. hare ze derech kelalut lichlalut yisrael.
Veaf shennittena hattora liddaresh bichlal uferat uferate feratut lechol nefesh peratit miyyisrael hammushereshet bah, hare en kol adam zoche lihyot makkir mekomo happerati shebbattora:

Vehinne, af behilchot issur vehetter hanniglot lanu ulevanenu, matzanu rainu machaloket tannaim veamoraim min hakkatze el hakkatze mammash, veellu vaellu divre elohim chayyim – leshon rabbim – al shem mekor hachayyim lenishmot yisrael hannechlakot derech kelal lishlosha kavvin, yamin usemol veemtza, shehem chesed ugevura vechulei, uneshamot sheshsharshan mimmiddat chesed, hanehagatan gam ken lehattot kelappe chesed – lehakel kulei kannoda.

Vechol shekken vekal vachomer behannistarot laAdonai elohenu deinun dechilu urechimu divmocha velibba dechol chad vechad lefum shiura dileh – lefum ma dimshaer belibbeh, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh al pasuk "noda bashshearim balah vegomer":

Ach beyodayy umakkirayy kaamina, hem kol echad veechad meanshe shelomenu shebbimdinatenu vesamochot shellah, asher haya haddibbur shel chibba matzuy benenu, vegillu lefanay kol taalumot libbam umocham baavodat Adonai hatteluya ballev, alehem tittof millati uleshoni et sofer – bekunetresim ellu hannikraim beshem "likkute amarim", melukkatim mippi sefarim umippi sofrim kedoshe elyon nishmatam eden hamefuresamim etzlenu.

Uketzat mehem nirmazin lechakkimin beiggerot hakkodesh merabbotenu shebbeeretz hakkodesh tibbane vetikkonen bimhera veyamenu amen, uketzatam shamati mippihem hakkadosh bihyotam po immanu, vechullam hen teshuvot al sheelot rabbot asher shoalin beetza kol anshe shelomenu dimdinatenu tamid kol echad lefi erko lashit etzot benafsham baavodat Adonai, lihyot ki en hazzeman gerama od lehashiv lechol echad veechad al sheelato bifratut, vegam hashshichcha metzuya.

Al ken rashamti kol hatteshuvot al kol hashsheelot lemishmeret leot, lihyot lechol echad veechad lezikkaron ben enav velo yidchok od likkanes ledabber immi bichidut, ki bahen yimtza margoa lenafsho veetza nechona lechol davar hakkashe alav baavodat Adonai, venachon yihye libbo batuach baAdonai gomer baadenu:

Umi sheddato ketzara lehavin devar etza mittoch kunetresim ellu, yefaresh sichatוֹ lifne haggedolim shebbeiro vehem yevonnuhu. vaalehem bakkashati, shello lasum yad lafe lehitnaheg baanava veshiflut shel sheker chas veshalom, vechannoda onesh hammar al monea bar, vegodel hassachar – mimmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al pasuk "meir ene shenehem Adonai", ki yair Adonai panav alehem, or pene melech chayyim. umechayye chayyim yezakkenu vichayyenu layyamim asher "lo yelammedu od ish et reehu vegomer ki chullam yedu oti vegomer ki mala haaretz dea et Adonai vegomer", amen ken yehi ratzon:

Vehinne, achar shennitpashshetu hakkunetresim hannizkarim leel, bekerev kol anshe shelomenu hannizkarim leel, behaetakot rabbot mide sofrim shonim umeshunnim, hinne al yede ribbuy hahatakot shonot, rabbu kemo rabbu hattauyyot-sofrim bimod meod, velazot, nadva rucham shel anashim efratim hannekuvim hannizkarim leel meever laddaf, litroach begufam umeodam lehavi et kunetresim hannizkarim leel levet haddefus menukkim mikkol sig vetauyyot-sofrim umuggahim hetev, veamina lefaala tava yishar chela.

Velihyot ki mikra male dibber hakkatuv "arur massig gevul reehu", vearur – bo kelala bo nidduy chas veshalom vechulei, al ken, kihuda veod likra kaatena – lemishde guda rabba al kol hammadpisim, shello lehadepis kunetresim hannizkarim leel, lo al yede atzman velo al yede gira dilhon, bilti reshut hannekuvim hannizkarim leel meshech chamesh shanim miyyom kelot haddefus. velashshomim yuneam, vetavo alehem birkat tov.
Ko divre hamelakket likkute amarim hannizkarim leel:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 1: Tanya [besof perek 3 denidda]: "mashbiim oto, tehi tzaddik veal tehi rasha. vaafilu kol haolam kullo omrim lecha tzaddik atta – heye veenecha kerasha".
Vetzarich lehavin, deha tenan [avot perek 2]: "veal tehi rasha bifne atzmecha".
Vegam, im yihye veenav kerasha – yera levavo veyihye atzev, velo yuchal laavod Adonai besimcha uvetuv levav, veim lo yera levavo kelal mizze, yachol lavo lide kallut, chas veshalom.
Ach hainyan, ki hinne matzinu baggemara Adonai chalukkot: tzaddik vetov lo, tzaddik vera lo, rasha vetov lo, rasha vera lo, uvenoni.

Ufershu baggemara: "tzaddik vetov 30וֹ – tzaddik gamur, tzaddik vera 30וֹ – tzaddik sheeno gamur". uveraya mehemna parashat mishpatim perash: tzaddik vera 30וֹ – shehara shebbo kafuf lattov vechulei, uvaggemara sof perek 9 divrachot: "tzaddikim – yetzer tov shoftan kulei, reshaim – yetzer hara shoftan, benonim – ze vaze shoftan vechulei. amar rabba: kegon ana benoni. amar leh abbayye: lo shavik mar chayye lechol biryya vechulei".
Ulehavin kol ze baer hetev, vegam lehavin ma sheamar iyyov [bava batra perek 1]: "ribbono shel olam, barata tzaddikim barata reshaim kulei", veha ‘tzaddik verasha lo kaamar!

Vegam lehavin mahut madregat habbenoni, shebbevadday eno mechetza zechuyyot umechetza avonot, sheim ken, ech taa rabba beatzmo lomar shehu benoni, venoda dela fasik pumeh miggirsa, ad sheafilu malach hammavet lo haya yachol lishlot bo, veech haya yachol litot bemechetza avonot chas veshalom?

Veod, shehare beshaa sheose avonot nikra rasha gamur [veim achar-kach asa teshuva – nikra tzaddik gamur], vaafilu haover al issur kal shel divre sofrim – mikre rasha, kidita beferek 2 divamot uveferek kamma denidda.
Vaafilu mi sheyyesh beyado limchot velo micha nikra rasha [beferek 6 dishvuot].

Vechol shekken vekal vachomer, bimvattel ezo mitzvat ase sheefshar lo lekayyeymah, kemוֹ kol sheefshar lo laasok battora veeno osek, shealav darshu rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "ki devar Adonai baza vegomer hikkaret tikkaret vegomer". ufeshita demikre rasha tefe meover issur derabbanan.
Veim ken, al karchacha habbenoni en bo afilu avon bittul tora, umishshum hache taa rabba beatzmo lomar shehu benoni

Haggaha
uma shekkatuv bazzohar chelek 3 daf 231: kol shemmemuﬠtin ﬠvonotav vechulei, hi sheelat rav hamenuna leeliyyahu, aval lefi teshuvat eliyyahu sham, perush "tzaddik vera lo" hu kemo shekkatuv beraﬠya mehemna parasha mishpatim dilﬠyl. veshivﬠym panim lattora:

Veha deamrinan bealma, demechetza al mechetza mikre benoni, verov zechuyyot mikre tzaddik, hu shem hammusheal leinyan sachar veonesh, lefi shenniddon achar rubbo, umikre tzaddik bedino meachar shezzoche baddin, aval leinyan amittat shem hattoar vehammaala shel maalat umadregot chalukot tzaddikim uvenonim, amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "tzaddikim yetzer tov shoftan, shenneemar: velibbi chalal bekirbi" – sheen lo yetzer hara, ki harago betaanit; aval kol mi shello higgia lemadrega zo, af shezzechuyotav merubbim al avonotav – eno bemaalat umadregat tzaddik kelal.
Velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha bammidrash: "raa hakkadosh-baruch-hu batztzaddikim shehem muatim – amad ushetalan bechol dor vador vechulei, uchemo shekkatuv: vetzaddik yesod olam":

Ach beur hainyan, al pi ma shekkatav harav chayyim vital zichrono livracha beshaar hakkedushsha [uveetz chayyim shaar 50 perek 2], dilchol ish yisrael, echad tzaddik veechad rasha, yesh shete neshamot, dichtiv: "uneshamot ani asiti", shehen shete nefashot –nefesh achat mitztzad hakkelippa vesitra ochora, vehi hammitlabbeshet bedam haadam lehachayot hagguf, uchedichtiv: "ki nefesh habbasar baddam hi", umimmenna baot kol hammiddot raot, mearba yesodot raim shebbah, dehayynu: kaas vegaava – misod haesh shennigbah lemala, vetaavat hattaanugim – misod hammayim, ki hammayim matzmichim kol mine taanug, veholelut veletzanut vehitpaarut udevarim betelim – misod haruach, veatzlut veatzvut – misod heafar.
Vegam middot tovot shebbeteva kol yisrael betoldotam, kemo rachamanut ugemilut chasadim – baot mimmenna.
Ki beyisrael nefesh zo diklippa, hi mikkelippat noga, sheyyesh bah gam ken tov, vehi missod "etz haddaat tov vara":

Ma sheen ken nafshot ummot haolam, hen mishshear kelippot temeot, sheen bahen tov kelal, kemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim shaar 49 perek 3. vechol tivu deavdin haummot legarmayyhu avdin, vechidita baggemara al pasuk: "vechesed leummim chattat" –shekkol tzedaka vachesed sheummot haolam osin, enan ella lehityayher kulei:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 2: Venefesh hashshenit beyisrael, hi chelek eloah mimmaal mammash, kemo shekkatuv: "vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim", veatta nafachta bi", uchemo shekkatuv bazzohar, man denafach mittocheh nafach, perush, mittochiyyuto umippenimiyyuto, shettochiyyut ufenimiyyut hachayyut shebbaadam motzi binfichato bechoach:

Kach, al derech mashal, nishmot yisrael alu bemachashava, kedichtiv: "beni vechori yisrael", "banim attem laAdonai elohechem" perush, kemo shehabben nimshach mimmoach haav, kach kivyachol nishmat kol ish yisrael nimshecha mimmachashavto vechachmato yitbarech, deihu chakkim vela vechachma yedia, ella hu vechachmato echad, uchemo shekkatav harambam,

Haggaha
vehodu lo chachme hakkabbala, kemo shekkatuv bappardes meharamak. vegam lefi kabbalat haari zichrono livracha yatztziva milleta, besod hitlabbeshut or-en-sof baruch-hu, ﬠl-yede tzimtzumim rabbim, bechelim dechachma-bina-daﬠt daatzilut, ach lo lemaﬠla mehaatzilut, uchemo shekkatuv bemakom acher, sheen-sof-baruch-hu meromam umitnasse rommut en ketz, lemaﬠla maﬠla mimmahut uvechinat chachma-bina-daﬠt, ﬠd shemmahut uvechinat chachma-bina-daﬠt nechshevet kaﬠsiyyay gufaniyyit etzlo yitbarech, kemo shekkatuv: "kullam bechachma ﬠsita":
Shehu hammadda vehu hayyodea kulei, vedavar ze en bicholet haadam lahavino al bureyo kulei, kedichtiv: "hacheker eloah timtza", uchetiv: "ki lo machshevotay machshevotechem vegomer".

Veaf sheyyesh rivvot mine chilluke madregot banneshamot, gavoah meal gavoah leen ketz, kemo godel maalat nishmot haavot umoshe rabbenu alehem-hashshalom, al nishmot dorotenu elle deikve meshicha, shehem bechinat akevayim mammash legabbe hammoach veharosh; vechen bechol dor vador yesh rashe alfe yisrael, shennishmotehem hem bechinat rosh umoach legabbe nishmot hehamon veamme haaretz; vechen nefashot legabbe nefashot, ki kol nefesh kelula minnefesh ruach uneshama.

Mikkol makom, shoresh kol hannefesh ruach uneshama kullam, merosh kol hammadregot ad sof kol dargin, hamelubbash beguf amme haaretz vekal shebbekalim, nimshach mimmoach haelyon, shehi chachma illaa kivyachol.

Kimshal habben hannimshach mimmoach haav, sheafilu tzipparne raglav nithauu mittippa zo mammash, al yede shehiyyaytah tisha chodashim beveten haem, veyarda mimmadrega lemadrega, lehishtannot ulehithauot mimmenna tzipparnayim.

Veim kol ze, odenna keshura umeyuchedet beyichud nifla veatzum bemahutah veatzmutah harishon shehayta tippat moach haav; vegam achshav babben, yenikat hatztzipparnayim vechayyutam nimshechet mehammoach shebbarosh; kidita baggemara [nidda sham]: "loven, shemmimmennu gidim vaatzamot vetzipparnayim" [uchemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim shaar hachashmal, besod levushim shel adam harishon began eden, shehayu tzipparnayim mibbechinat moach tevuna].

Vechacha mammash, kivyachol, beshoresh kol hannefesh ruach uneshama shel kelalut yisrael lemala, biridato mimmadrega lemadrega al yede hishtalshelut haolamot atzilut-beria-yetzira-asiyya mechachmato yitbarech, kedichtiv: "kullam bechachma asita", nithauu mimmennu nefesh ruach uneshama shel amme haaretz ufechute haerech.

Veim kol ze, odena keshurot umeyuchadot beyichud nifla veatzum bemahutan veatzmutan harishon, shehi hameshachat chachma illaa, ki yenikat vechayyut nefesh ruach uneshama shel amme haaretz, hu minnefesh ruach uneshama shel hatztzaddikim vehachachamim rashe bene yisrael shebbedoram:

Uvaze yuvan maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al pasuk: "uledavka vo" – shekkol haddavek betalmide chachamim, maale alav hakkatuv keillu nidbak bashshechina mammash, ki al yede devika betalmide chachamim, keshurot nefesh ruach uneshama shel amme haaretz umeyuchadot bemahutan harishon vesharsham shebbechachma illaa, shehu yitbarech vechachmato echad, vehu hammadda kulei.
[Vehapposhim umordim betalmide chachamim – yenikat nefesh ruach uneshama shellahem mibbechinat achorayim shel nefesh ruach venishmat talmide chachamim].

Uma shekkatuv bazzohar uvezohar chadash, shehaikkar taluy sheyyekaddesh atzmo bishat tashmish davvka, ma sheen ken bene amme haaretz kulei, hayeynu, mishshum sheen lecha nefesh ruach uneshama sheen lah levush minnefesh deatzmut aviv veimmo, vechol hammitzvot sheose – hakkol al yede oto hallevush kulei, vaafilu hashshefa shennotnim lo min hashshamayim – hakkol al yede levush ze, veim yekaddesh et atzmo – yamshich levush kadosh lenishmat beno, vaafilu hi neshama gedola, tzericha lekiddush aviv kulei.

Aval hanneshama atzmah, hinne lifamim nishmat adam gavoah leen ketz, ba lihyot beno shel adam nivze veshafal kulei, kemo shekkatav haari zichrono livracha kol ze belikkute tora" parashat vayyera uvetaame mitzvot parashat bereshit:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 3: Vehinne, kol bechina umadrega mishshalosh ellu: nefesh ruach uneshama – kelula meeser bechinot, keneged eser sefirot elyonot shennishtalshelu mehen, hannechlakot lishtayim, shehen: shalosh immot vesheva kefulot; perush, chachma bina vadaat, veshivat yeme habbinyan: chesed gevura tiferet kulei.
Vechach benefesh haadam, shennechleket lishtayim: sechel umiddot.
Hassechel kolel: chachma bina vadaat, vehammiddot hen: ahavat Adonai ufachdo veyirato ulefaaro kulei.
Vechachma-bina-daat nikreu immot umakor lammiddot, ki hammiddot hen toldot chachma-bina-daat:
Uveur hainyan, ki hinne hassechel shebbannefesh hammaskelet, shehu hammaskil kol davar – nikra beshem "chachma", "koach ma".
Ucheshemmotzi kocho el happoal, shemmitbonen besichlo lehavin davar laashuro uleamko, mittoch eze devar chachma hammusekol besichlo – nikra "bina".
Vehen hem "av" vaem" hammolidot ahavat Adonai veyirato ufachdo.

Ki hassechel shebbannefesh hammaskelet, keshemmitbonen umaamik meod bigdullat Adonai, ech hu "memalle kol almin" vesovev kol almin" vechulla kammeh kela chashiv" nolda venitorra middat yirat harommut bemocho umachashavto, liro ulehitboshesh miggedullato yitbarech sheen lah sof vetachlit, ufachad Adonai belibbo.
Veshuv yitlahev libbo beahava azza kerishpe esh, bachashika vachafitza uteshuka venefesh shokeka, ligdullat en-sof baruch-hu.
Vehi kelot hannefesh, kedichtiv: "nichsefa vegam kalta nafshi vegomer", uchetiv: "tzama nafshi lelohim vegomer", uchetiv: "tzama lecha nafshi vegomer".

Vehatztzimmaon, hu misod haesh shebbannefesh haelohit, uchemo shekkatvu hattiviyyim, vechen hu beetz chayyim, sheyyesod haesh hu ballev, umekor hammayim vehallechot mehammoach, uchemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim shaar 50, shehi bechinat chachma shennikra mayim shebbannefesh haelohit.
Ushear hammiddot kullan, hen anfe hayyira vehaahava vetoldotehen, kemo shekkatuv bemakom acher.

Vehaddaat, hu milleshon "vehaadam yada et chavva", vehu leshon hitkashsherut vehitchabberut, shemmekashsher dato bekesher ammitz vechazak meod, veyitka machashavto bechozek bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu, veeno massiach dato.
Ki af mi shehu chacham venavon bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu, hinne im lo yekashsher dato veyitka machashavto bechozek uvehatmada – lo yolid benafsho yira veahava amittit, ki im dimyonot shav.
Veal ken, haddaat hu kiyyum hammiddot vechayyutan, vehu kolel chesed ugevura, perush, ahava vaanafeha veyira vaanafeha:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 4: Veod yesh lechol nefesh elohit shelosha levushim, shehem machashava dibbur umaase shel taryag mitzvot hattora; shekkeshehaadam mekayyem bemaase kol mitzvot maasiyyot, uvedibbur hu osek beferush kol taryag mitzvot vehilchotehen, uvemachashava hu massig kol ma sheefshar lo lehassig bifshat-remez-derush-sod hattora – hare kelalut taryag evre nafsho melubbashim betaryag mitzvot hattora.

Uvifratut, bechinot chachma-bina-daat shebbenafsho, melubbashot behassagat hattora shehu massig bifshat-remez-derush-sod kefi yecholet hassagato veshoresh nafsho lemala; vehammiddot, shehen yira veahava veanfehen vetoldotehen – melubbashot bekiyyum hammitzvot bemaase uvedibbur, shehu talmud tora shekkeneged kullan.

Ki haahava hi shoresh kol ramach mitzvot ase, umimmenna hen nimshachot, uviladah en lahen kiyyum amitti, ki hammekayyeman beemet hu haohev et shem Adonai vechafetz ledavka bo beemet, vei efshar ledavka bo beemet, ki im bekiyyum ramach pekudin, shehem ramach evarin demalka kivyachol, kemo shekkatuv bemakom acher. vehayyira hi shoresh leshasa lo taase, ki yare limrod bemelech malche hammelachim hakkadosh-baruch-hu.

O yira penimit mizzo, shemmitboshesh miggedullato, lamrot ene chevodo velaasot hara beenav, kol toavat Adonai asher sane, hem hakkelippot vesitra ochora, asher yenikatam mehaadam hattachton vaachizatam bo hu beshasa mitzvot lo taase.

Vehinne, shelosha levushim ellu mehattora umitzvoteha, af shennikraim levushim lenefesh ruach uneshama im kol ze, gavha vegadla maalatam leen ketz vesof al maalat nefesh ruach uneshama atzman, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar, deorayyta vekudesha-berich-hu kulla chad, perush: deorayyta, hi chachmato uretzono shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu, vehakkadosh-baruch-hu bichvodo uveatzmo – kulla chad, ki hu hayyodea vehu hammadda vechulei, kemo shennitbaer leel beshem harambam.

Veaf dehakkadosh-baruch-hu nikra "en sof", veligdullato en cheker, velet machashava tefisa veh kelal, vechen birtzono vechachmato, kedichtiv: "en cheker litvunato", uchetiv: "hacheker eloah timtza", uchetiv: "ki lo machshevotay machshevotechem".

Hinne al ze amru: "bemakom sheatta motze gedullato shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu, sham atta motze anvetanuto", vetzimtzem hakkadosh-baruch-hu retzono vechachmato betaryag mitzvot hattora uvehilchotehen, uvetzerufe otiyyot tora-neviim-ketuvim, uderashotehen shebbeaggadot umidreshe chachamenu-zichronam-livracha.

Bichde shekkol hanneshama o ruach vanefesh shebbeguf haadam, tuchal lehassigan bedatah, ulekayyeyman – kol ma sheefshar lekayyem mehen bemaase dibbur umachashava, veal yede ze titlabbesh bechol eser bechinoteha bishlosha levushim ellu.

Velachen nimshela hattora lemayim; ma mayim yordim mimmakom gavoah lemakom namuch, kach hattora yarda mimmekom kevodah, shehi retzono vechachmato yitbarech, veorayyta vekudesha-berich-hu kulla chad, velet machashava tefisa veh kelal.

Umishsham nasa veyarda beseter hammadregot, mimmadrega lemadrega, behishtalshelut haolamot, ad shennitlabbesha bidvarim gashmiyyim veinyeyne olam hazze, shehen rov mitzvot hattora kechullam vehilchotehen, uvetzerufe otiyyot gashmiyyot bidyo al hassefer, esrim vearbaa sefarim shebbetora neviim uchetuvim. kede shettehe kol machashava tefisa bahen, vaafilu bechinat dibbur umaase, shellematta mimmadregat machashava, tefisa bahen umitlabbeshet bahen.

Umeachar shehattora umitzvoteha malbishim kol eser bechinot hannefesh vechol taryag evareha meroshah vead raglah, hare kullah tzerura bitzror hachayyim et Adonai mammash, veor Adonai mammash makkifah umalbishah meroshah vead raglah, kemo shekkatuv: "tzuri echese bo", uchetiv: "katztzinna ratzon taterennu", shehu retzono vechachmato yitbarech hamelubbashim betorato umitzvoteha.

Velachen amru: "yafa shaa achat bitshuva umaasim tovim baolam hazze mikkol chayye olam habba", ki olam habba hu shennehenin mizziv hashshechina, shehu taanug hahassaga, vei efshar leshum nivra, afilu mehaelyonim, lehassig, ki im ezo heara meor Adonai, velachen nikra beshem "ziv hashshechina"; aval hakkadosh-baruch-hu bichvodo uveatzmo – let machashava tefisa veh kelal, ki im kaasher tefisa umitlabbeshet battora umitzvoteha, azay hi tefisa umitlabbeshet behakkadosh-baruch-hu mammash, deorayyta vekudesha-berich-hu kulla chad.

Veaf shehattora nitlabbesha bidvarim tachtonim gashmiyyim – hare ze kimchabbek et hammelech derech mashal, sheen hefresh bemaalat hitkarvuto udevekuto bammelech, ben mechabbeko keshehu lavush levush echad ben shehu lavush kamma levushim, meachar shegguf hammelech betocham.
Vechen im hammelech mechabbeko bizroo, gam shehi melubbeshet toch malbushav, kemo shekkatuv: "vimino techabbekeni", shehi hattora shennittena miyyamin, shehi bechinat chesed umayim:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 5: Uletosefet beur, baer hetev leshon "tefisa" sheamar eliyyahu: "let machashava tefisa vach kulei".
Hinne, kol sechel keshemmaskil umassig besichlo eze musekol, hare hassechel tofes et hammusekol umakkifo besichlo, vehammusekol nitpas umukkaf umelubbash betoch hassechel shehissigo vehiskilo.

Vegam hassechel melubbash bammusekol beshaa shemmassigo vetofso besichlo. derech mashal: kesheadam mevin umassig ezo halacha bemishna o bigmara laashurah al bureyah hare sichlo tofes umakkif otah, vegam sichlo melubbash bah beotah shaa.
Vehinne, halacha zo, hi chachmato uretzono shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu, sheala birtzono, shekkesheyyiton reuven kach vechach derech mashal veshimon kach vechach – yihye happesak benehem kach vechach.

Veaf im lo haya velo yihye haddavar hazze leolam, lavo lemishpat al teanot uteviot ellu, mikkol makom, meachar shekkach ala birtzono vechachmato shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu, sheim yiton ze kach veze kach, yihye happesak kach, hare kesheadam yodea umassig besichlo pesak ze kahalacha haarucha bemishna o gemara o poskim, hare ze massig vetofes umakkif besichlo retzono vechachmato shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu, delet machashava tefisa beh velo birtzono vechachmato, ki im behitlabbeshutam bahalachot haaruchot lefanenu, vegam sichlo melubbash bahem.
Vehu yichud nifla sheen yichud kamohu velo keerko nimtza kelal begashmiyyut, lihyot laachadim umeyuchadim mammash mikkol tzad ufinna.

Vezot maala yetera gedola veniflaa leen ketz asher bemitzvat yediat hattora vehassagatah al kol hammitzvot maasiyyot, vaafilu al mitzvot hatteluyot bedibbur, vaafilu al mitzvat talmud tora shebbedibbur.

Ki al yede kol hammitzvot shebbedibbur umaase, hakkadosh-baruch-hu malbish et hannefesh, umakkifah or Adonai meroshah vead raglah, uvidiat hattora, millevad shehassechel melubbash bechachmat Adonai, hinne gam chachmat Adonai bekirbo – ma shehassechel massig vetofes umakkif besichlo ma sheefshar lo litpos ulehassig midiat hattora, ish kefi sichlo vechoach yediato vehassagato bifshat-remez-derush-sod.
Ulefi shebbidiat hattora, hattora melubbeshet benefesh haadam vesichlo umukkefet betocham, lachen nikret beshem "lechem" umezon hannefesh".

Ki kemo shehallechem haggashmi zan et hagguf keshemmachniso betocho vekirbo mammash, venehpach sham lihyot dam uvasar kivsaro, vaazay yichye veyitkayyem, kach bidiat hattora vehassagatah benefesh haadam shellomdah hetev beiyyun sichlo ad shennitpeset besichlo umitachedet immo vehayu laachadim – naasa mazon lannefesh vechayyim bekirbah, mechayye hachayyim en-sof baruch-hu hamelubbash bechachmato vetorato shebbekirbah.

Vezehu shekkatuv: "vetoratcha betoch meay", uchemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim" shaar 44 perek 3, shellevushe hanneshamot began eden hen hammitzvot, vehattora hi hammazon lanneshamot sheasku baolam hazze battora lishmah, uchemo shekkatuv bazzohar vayyakhel daf 210.
Velishmah", hayeynu kede lekashsher nafsho laAdonai al yede hassagat hattora, ish kefi sichlo, kemo shekkatuv bifri etz chayyim".

[Vehammazon hi bechinat or penimi, vehallevushim bechinat makkifim. velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha, shettalmud tora shakul keneged kol hammitzvot, lefi shehammitzvot hen levushim levad, vehattora hi mazon vegam levush lannefesh hammaskelet, shemmitlabbesh bah beiyyunah velimmudah, vechol shekken keshemmotzi befiv bedibbur, shehevel haddibbur naase bechinat or makkif, kemo shekkatuv bifri etz chayyim"]:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 6: Vehinne, ze leummat ze asa elohim.

Ki kemo shennefesh haelohit kelula meeser sefirot kedoshot, umitlabbeshet bishlosha levushim kedoshim, kach hannefesh desitra ochora mikkelippot noga hamelubbeshet bedam haadam, kelula meeser kitrin dimsaavuta, shehen: sheva middot raot habbaot mearba yesodot raim hannizkarim leel, vesechel hammolidan hannechlak leshalosh, shehen chachma bina vadaat – mekor hammiddot, ki hammiddot hen lefi erech hassechel, ki hakkatan choshek veohev devarim ketannim pechute haerech, lefi shessichlo katan vekatzar lehassig devarim yekarim yoter mehem, vechen mitkaes umitkatztzef middevarim ketannim, vechen behitpaarut ushear middot.

Veeser bechinot ellu hattemeot, kesheadam mechashshev bahen o medabber o ose, hare machashavto shebbemocho vedibburo shebbefiv vechoach hammaasiy shebbeyadav ushear evarav, nikraim "levushe mesaavu" leeser bechinot ellu hattemeot, shemmitlabbeshot bahen bishat maase o dibbur o machashava.

Vehen hem kol hammaasim asher naasim tachat hashshemesh, asher "hakkol hevel ureut ruach", uchemo shekkatuv bazzohar beshallach, shehen "teviru derucha kulei", vechen kol haddibburim vechol hammachashavot asher lo laAdonai hemma velirtzono velaavodato, shezzehu perush leshon "sitra ochora", perush – tzad acher, sheeno tzad hakkedushsha.

Vetzad hakkedushsha eno ella hasheraa vehameshacha mikkedushshato shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu, veen hakkadosh-baruch-hu shore ella al davar shebbatel etzlo yitbarech, ben befoal mammash – kemalachim elyonim, ben bechoach – kechol ish yisrael lematta, shebbechocho lihyot batel mammash legabbe hakkadosh-baruch-hu bimsirat nafsho al kedushshat Adonai.
Velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha, sheafilu echad sheyyoshev veosek battora – shechina sheruya kulei, vechol be asara shechinta sharya" leolam.

Aval kol ma sheeno batel etzlo yitbarech, ella hu davar nifrad bifne atzmo, eno mekabbel chayyut mikkedushshato shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu mibbechinat penimit hakkedushsha umahutah veatzmutah bichvodah uveatzmah, ella mibbechinat achorayim, sheyyordim mimmadrega lemadrega rivvot madregot, behishtalshelut haolamot derech illa vealul vetzimtzumim rabbim, ad shennitmaet kol kach haor vehachayyut, miut achar miut, ad sheyyachol lehittzamtzem ulehitlabbesh bivchinat galut toch oto davar hannifrad, lehachayoto ulekayyeymo meayin leyesh, shello yachazor lihyot ayin vaefes kevattechilla mikkodem shennivra.
Velachen nikra olam hazze umeloo, olam hakkelippot vesitra ochora. velachen kol maase olam hazze kashim veraim, veharshaim govrim bo, kemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim shaar 42 sof perek 4.

Ella shehakkelippot hen nechlakot lishte madregot, zo lematta mizzo.
Hammadrega hattachtona, hi shalosh kelippot hattemeot veraot legamre, veen bahem tov kelal, venikreu bemirkevet yechezkel "ruach seara" veanan gadol vegomer".

Umehen nishpaot venimshachot nafshot kol ummot haolam, vekiyyum gufam, venafshot kol baale chayyim hattemeim vaasurim baachila, vekiyyum gufam, vekiyyum vechayyut kol maachalot asurot mehatztzomeach, kemo arla vechile hakkerem kulei, uchemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim shaar 49 perek 6, vechen kiyyum vechayyut kol hammaase dibbur umachashava shel kol shasa lo taase veanfehen, kemo shekkatuv sham sof perek Adonai:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 7: Ach nefesh hachiyyunit habbahamit shebbeyisrael shemmitztzad hakkelippa, hamelubbeshet bedam haadam kannizkar leel, venafshot behemot vechayyot veofot vedagim tehorim umuttarim baachila, vekiyyum vechayyut kol haddomem vechol hatztzomeach hammuttar baachila, vechen kiyyum vechayyut kol hammaase dibbur umachashava beinyeyne olam hazze sheen bahem tzad issur, lo shoresh velo anaf mishshasa mitzvot lo taase veanfehen deorayyta uderabbanan, rak sheenan leshem shamayim – ella retzon hagguf vecheftzo vetaavato, vaafilu hu tzorech hagguf vekiyyumo vechayyuto mammash, ella shekkavvavnato enah leshem shamayim kede laavod et Adonai begufo – la adife maase dibbur umachashavot ellu minnefesh hachiyyunit habbahamit beatzmah, vehakkol kaasher lakkol, nishpa venimshach mimmadrega hashshenit shebbiklippot vesitra ochora, shehi kelippa reviit hannikret "kelippat noga", shebbaolam hazze, hannikra "olam haasiyya", rubbo kechullo ra, rak meat tov meorav betochah [shemmimmenna baot middot tovot shebbannefesh habbahamit shebbeyisrael, kemo shennitbaer leel].
Vehi bechina memutztzaat ben shalosh kelippot hattemeot legamre uven bechinat umadregat hakkedushsha.

Velachen, peamim shehi nichlelet beshalosh kelippot hattemeot [kemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim shaar 49 resh perek 4 beshem hazzohar], ufeamim shehi nichlelet veola bivchinat umadregat hakkedushsha, dehayynu, keshehattov hameorav bah nitbarer mehara vegover veole venichlal bikdushsha.

Kegon derech mashal: haochel bisra shemena detora veshote yayin mevussam leharechiv dato laAdonai uletorato, kidamar rava: "chamra verecha kulei", o bishvil kede lekayyem mitzvat oneg shabbat veyom tov, azay, nitbarer chayyut habbasar vehayyayin shehaya nishpa mikkelippat noga, veole laAdonai keola uchekarban.

Vechen haomer milleta divdichuta lefakkeach dato ulesammeach libbo laAdonai uletorato vaavodato, shetztzerichim lihyot besimcha, uchemo sheasa rava letalmidav sheamar lifnehem milleta divdichuta techilla uvadche rabbanan.

Ach mi shehu bezolle basar vesove yayin, lemallot taavat gufo venafsho habbahamit, shehu bechinat yesod hammayim mearba yesodot haraim shebbah shemmimmennu middat hattaava, hinne al yede ze yored chayyut habbasar vehayyayin shebbekirbo, venichlal lefi shaa bera gamur shebbeshalosh kelippot hattemeot, vegufo naase lahen levush umerkava lefi shaa. ad asher yashuv haadam veyachazor laavodat Adonai uletorato, ki lefi shehaya besar hetter veyayin kasher, lechach yecholim lachazor velaalot immo beshuvo laavodat Adonai, shezzehu leshon "hetter" umuttar", kelomar sheeno kashur veasur bide hachitzonim shello yuchal lachazor velaalot laAdonai.
Rak sheharshimu mimmennu nishar bagguf, veal ken tzarich hagguf lechibbut hakkever, kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman.
Vechen hachayyut shebbetippot zera sheyyatzu mimmennu betaava bahamit, shello kiddesh atzmo bishat tashmish im ishto tehora.

Ma sheen ken bemaachalot asurot uviot asurot, shehen mishshalsh kelippot hattemeot legamre – hem asurim ukeshurim bide hachitzonim leolam, veen olim mishsham ad ki yavo yomam vivulla hammavet lanetzach, kemo shekkatuv: "veet ruach hattumea aavir min haaretz"; o, ad sheyyaase teshuva gedola kol kach shezzedonot naasu lo kizchuyyot mammash, shehi teshuva meahava meumeka delibba beahava rabba vachashika venefesh shokeka ledavka bo yitbarech, vetzama nafsho laAdonai keeretz ayefa vetziyya, lihyot ki ad henna hayta nafsho beeretz tziyya vetzalmavet, hi hassitra ochora, urechoka meor pene Adonai betachlit, velazot tzama nafsho beyeter oz mitztzimon nafshot hatztzaddikim, kemaamaram zichronam livracha: "bemakom shebbaale teshuva omdim kulei".
Veal teshuva meahava rabba zo amru shezzedonot naasu lo kizchuyyot", hoil veal yede ze ba leahava rabba zo.
Aval teshuva shello meahava zo, af shehi teshuva nechona, vaAdonai yislach lo, mikkol makom lo naasu lo kizchuyyot, veen olim mehakkelippa legamre ad et ketz, sheyyevulla hammavet lanetzach.

Ach hachayyut shebbetippot zera sheyyatzu mimmennu levattala, af sheyyarda venichlela beshalsh kelippot hattemeot – hare zo ola mishsham bitshuva nechona, uvechavvavna atzuma bikriat-shema-sheal-hammitta, kannoda mehaari zichrono livracha, umerummaz baggemara: "kol hakkore keriat shema al mittato keillu ochez cherev shel shete fiyyot kulei", laharog gufot hachitzonim shennaasu levush lachayyut shebbattippot, veola hachayyut mehem, kayyadua leyode chen.

Velachen lo huzekar avon zera levattala battora bichlal biot asurot, af shechamur mehen, vegadol avono bivchinat haggadlut veribbuy hattumea vehakkelippot shemmolid umarbe bimod meod behotzaat zera levattala, yoter mibbiot asurot. rak, shebbeviot asurot mosif koach vechayyut biklippa temea beyoter, ad sheeno yachol lehaalot mishsham hachayyut bitshuva,

Haggaha
mippene shennikleta bisod denukeva diklippa hamekabbelet vekoletet hachayyut mehakkedushsha, ma sheen ken bezera levattala, sheen sham bechinat nukeva diklippa, rak shekkochoteha vechayyloteha malbishim lachayyut shebbattippot, kayyaduﬠ leyodﬠy chen:
Ella im ken yaase teshuva meahava rabba kol kach, ad shezzedonot naasu lo kizchuyyot.

Uvaze yuvan maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "ezehu meuvvavt shello yuchal litkon – ze shebba al haerva veholid mamzer", sheaz, gam im yaase teshuva gedola kol kach, i efshar lo lehaalot hachayyut likdushsha, meachar shekkevar yarda laolam hazze venitlabbesha beguf basar vadam:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 8: Veod zot bemaachalot asurot, shellechach nikraim beshem "issur", mippene sheaf mi sheachal maachal issur belo hoda – leshem shamayim, laavod Adonai bechoach achila hahi, vegam paal veasa ken, vekara vehitpallel bechoach achila hahi, en hachayyut shebbah ola umitlabbeshet betevot hattora vehattefilla kemo hahetter, mippene issurah bide hassitra ochora mishshalosh kelippot hattemeot. vaafilu hu issur derabbanan, shechamurim divre sofrim yoter middivre tora kulei.
Velachen, gam hayyetzer hara vechoach hammitavve lidvarim haasurim, hu shed mishshedin nucherain, shehu yetzer hara shel ummot haolam, shennafshotehem mishshalosh kelippot hattemeot.

Ma sheen ken hayyetzer hara vechoach hammitavve lidvarim hammuttarim lemallot taavato, hu shed mishshedin yehudain, lefi sheyyachol lachazor likdushsha kedilel. ach mikkol makom, kodem shechazar likdushsha, hu sitra ochora ukelippa. vegam achar kach, harshimu mimmennu nishar davuk bagguf, lihyot ki mikkol maachol umashke naasa techef dam uvasar mibbesaro.

Velachen tzarich hagguf lechibbut hakkever, lenakkoto uletaharo mittumeato shekkibbel bahanaat olam hazze vetaanugav mittumeat kelippat noga veshedin yehudain. ella im ken mi shello nehena meolam hazze kol yamav kerabbenu hakkadosh.

Veal devarim betelim behetter, kegon am haaretz sheeno yachol lilmod, tzarich letaher nafsho mittumea zo diklippa zo, al yede gilgulah bechaf hakkela, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar parashat beshallach daf 59.

Aval ledibburim asurim, kemo letzanut velashon hara vechayyotze vahem, shehen mishshalosh kelippot hattemeot legamre – en kaf hakkela [levaddo] moil letaher ulehaavir tumeato mehannefesh, rak tzericha lered legehinnom.

Vechen mi sheefshar lo laasok battora veosek bidvarim betelim – en kaf hakkela levaddo moil lenafsho lemarkah ulezakkechah, rak onashim chamurim shemmaanishim al bittul tora bifratut, millevad onesh hakkelali lechol bittul mitzvat ase mechamat atzlut begehinnom shel sheleg, kimvoar bemakom acher.
Vechen haosek bechachmot ummot haolam – bichlal devarim betelim yechashev leinyan avon bittul tora, kemo shekkatuv behilchot talmud tora.

Veod zot yetera tumeatah shel chachmat haummot al tumeat devarim betelim, sheeno malbish umetamme rak hammiddot, misod haruach hakkadosh shebbenafsho haelohit, betumeat kelippat noga shebbidvarim betelim, habbaim misod haruach hara shebbiklippa zo benafsho habbahamit kedilel, velo bechinot chachma-bina-daat shebbenafsho, meachar shehem divre shetut uvurut, sheggam hashshotim veamme haaretz yecholim ledabber ken.

Ma sheen ken bechachmat haummot, hu malbish umetamme bechinot chachma-bina-daat shebbenafsho haelohit betumeat kelippat noga shebbechachmot ellu, shennaflu shamma bishvirat hakkelim mibbechinat achorayim shel chachma dikdushsha, kayyadua leyode chen.

Ella im ken ose otan kardom lachtoch bahen, dehayynu kede lehitparnes mehen berevach laavod Adonai, o sheyyodea lehishtammesh bahen laavodat Adonai o letorato, vezehu taamo shel harambam veramban zichronam livracha vesiatan sheasku bahen:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 9: Vehinne, mekom mishkan nefesh habbahamit shemmikkelippat noga bechol ish yisrael, hu ballev bechalal semali shehu male dam, uchetiv: "ki haddam hu hannafesh".

Velachen, kol hattaavot vehitpaarut vechaas vedomehen hen ballev, umehallev hen mitpashshetot bechol hagguf vegam ole lammoach shebbarosh, lechashshev uleharher bahen ulehitchakkem bahen, kemo shehaddam mekoro ballev, umehallev mitpashshet lechol haevarim vegam ole lehammoach shebbarosh.
Ach mekom mishkan nefesh haelohit, hu bammochin shebbarosh, umishsham mitpashshetet lechol haevarim, vegam ballev bechalal hayemani sheen bo dam, uchemo shekkatuv: "lev chacham limino".

Vehi ahavat Adonai kerishpe shalhevet mitlahevet belev maskilim hamevinim umitbonnim bedatam asher bemocham bidvarim hammeorrim et haahava. vechen simchat levav betiferet Adonai vahadar geono, kaasher ene hechacham asher berosho, bemoach chachmato uvinato, mistakkelim bikara demalka vetiferet gedullato ad en cheker veen sof vetachlit, kimvoar bemakom acher. vechen shear middot kedoshot shebballev, hen mechachma-bina-daat shebbammochin.

Ach hinne ketiv: "uleom milom yeematz", ki hagguf nikra "ir ketanna", uchemo sheshshene melachim nilchamim al ir achat, shekkol echad rotze lechavshah velimloch aleha, dehayynu, lehanehig yoshveha kirtzono vesheyyihyu sarim lemishmato bechol asher yigzor alehem, kach shete hannefashot, haelohit vehachiyyunit habbahamit shemmehakkelippa, nilchamot zo im zo al hagguf vechol evarav, shehaelohit – cheftzah uretzonah shettehe hi levaddah hammoshelet alav umanhigato, vechol haevarim yihyu sarim lemishmatah uvetelim etzlah legamre, umerkava eleha, veyihyu levush leeser bechinoteha veg levusheha hannizkarim leel, sheyyitlabbeshu chullam beevre hagguf, veyihye hagguf kullo male mehem levaddam, velo yaavor zar betocham chas veshalom, dehayynu, telat mochin shebbarosh yihyu memullaim mechachma-bina-daat shebbannefesh haelohit, shehi chachmat Adonai uvinato, lehitbonen bigdullato asher ad en cheker veen sof, uleholid mehen – al yede haddaat, hayyira bemocho ufachad Adonai belibbo, veahavat Adonai keesh boara belibbo kerishpe shalhevet, lihyot nichsefa vegam kalta nafsho bachashika vachafitza ledavka vo been-sof baruch-hu bechol lev venefesh umeod meumeka delibba shebbechalal hayemani, sheyyihye tocho ratzuf ahava male vegadush ad shettitpashshet gam lechalal hassemali leachpaya lesitra ochora yesod hammayim haraim shebbah, shehi hattaava shemmikkelippat noga, leshannotah ulehappechah mittaanuge olam hazze leahavat Adonai, kemo shekkatuv: "bechol levavcha" – "bishne yetzarecha".

Vehayeynu, sheyyaale veyavo veyaggia lemadregat ahava rabba vechibba yetera mimmadregat ahava azza kerishpe esh, vehi hannikret bakkatuv: "ahava betaanugim", lehitanneg al Adonai meen olam habba; vehaoneg – hu bemoach chachma vasechel, hammitanneg behasekalat Adonai vidiato, kefi hassagat sichlo vechachmato; vehu bechinat hammayim vezera or zarua shebbikdushshat nefesh haelohit, hamehappechet letov et bechinat hammayim shebbannefesh habbahamit, shemmehem bau taavot taanuge olam hazze mittechilla; uchemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim shaar 50 perek 3 beshem hazzohar, shehara nehpach lihyot tov gamur kemo yetzer tov mammash, behasir "habbegadim hatztzoim" mimmennu, shehem taanuge olam hazze shehu melubbash bahem.

Vechen shear kol hammiddot shebballev, shehen anfe hayyira vehaahava, yihyu laAdonai levaddo. vechol koach haddibbur shebbappe, vehammachashava shebbammoach, yihyu memullaim min levushe hammachashava vehaddibbur shel nefesh haelohit levaddah, shehen machashevet Adonai vetorato, lihyot sichato kol hayyom, la fasik pumeh miggirsa. vechoach hammaasiy shebbeyadav ushear ramach evarav yihye bemaase hammitzvot levad, shehu levush hashshelishi shel nefesh haelohit.
Ach nefesh habbahamit shemmehakkelippa, retzonah lehefech mammash – letovat haadam sheyyitgabber aleha vinatztzechenna, kimshal hazzona shebbazzohar hakkadosh:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 10: Vehinne, keshehaadam magbir nafsho haelohit venilcham kol kach im habbahamit, ad shemmegaresh umevaer hara shebbah mechalal hassemali, kemo shekkatuv: "uviarta hara mikkirbecha", veen hara nehpach letov mammash – nikra "tzaddik sheeno gamur" vetzaddik vera lo". dehayynu, sheyyesh bo adayin meat mizzeer ra bechalal hassemali, ella shekkafuf uvatel lattov mechamat miuto, velachen, nidme lo ki "vaygarshehu vayyelech lo" kullo legamre, aval beemet, illu chalaf vehalach lo legamre kol hara shebbo – haya nehpach letov mammash.

Uveur hainyan, ki hinne, tzaddik gamur shennehpach hara shello letov, velachen nikra "tzaddik vetov lo", hu al-yede hasarat "habbegadim hatztzoim" legamre mehara, dehayynu, limos meod betaanuge olam-hazze lehitanneg bam betaanugot bene adam lemallot taavat hagguf bilvad, velo laavodat Adonai, mippene heyotam nimshachim venishpaim mehakkelippa vesitra ochora. vechol ma shehu mehassitra ochora – hatztzaddik gamur hu sono betachlit hassina, mechamat godel ahavato laAdonai ukedushshato beahava rabba betaanugim vechibba yetera hannizkarim leel, ki hem ze leummat ze, kedichtiv: "tachlit sina senetim, leoyvim hayu li, chakreni veda levavi vegomer", uchefi erech godel haahava laAdonai, kach erech godel hassina lesitra ochora vehammius bara betachlit, ki hammius hu hefech haahava mammash kemo hassina.
Vetzaddik sheeno gamur, hu sheeno sone hassitra ochora betachlit hassina, velachen eno moes gam ken bara betachlit.

Vechol sheen hassina vehammius betachlit, al karchacha nishar eze shemetz ahava vetaanug lesham, velo huseru "habbegadim hatztzoim" legamre mikkol vachol, velachen lo nehpach letov mammash, meachar sheyyesh lo eze achiza adayin babbegadim hatztzoim", ella shehu batel bemiuto uchela chashiv, velachen nikra tzaddik vera – kafuf uvatel – lo. veal ken, gam ahavato laAdonai enah betachlit, velachen nikra tzaddik sheeno gamur.

Vehinne, madrega zo mitchalleket lerivvot madregot beinyan bechinat miut hara hannishar meachat mearba yesodot haraim, uveinyan bittulo bemiuto beshishshim al derech mashal, o beelef urevava vechayyotze al derech mashal. vehen hem bechinot tzaddikim harabbim shebbechol haddorot, kidita baggemara, ditamnesar alfe tzaddike kayyme kammeh hakkadosh-baruch-hu.

Ach al maalat tzaddik gamur, hu sheamar rabbi shimon ben yochai: "raiti bene aliyya vehem muatim kulei", shellachen nikraim "bene aliyya", shemmehappechin hara umaalim oto likdushsha, kidita bazzohar bahakedama, shekkesheratza rabbi chiyyay laalot lehechal rabbi shimon ben yochai, shama kala nafik veamar: "man minnechon di chashocha mehappechan linhora vetaamin meriru lemitka ad la yetun hacha vechulei":

Veod nikraim bene aliyya, mippene sheggam avodatam bivchinat "vaase tov" bekiyyum hattora umitzvoteha, hu letzorech gavoah umala mala ad rum hammaalot, velo kede ledavka bo yitbarech bilvad lerauot tzimon nafsham hatztzemea laAdonai, kemo shekkatuv: "hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim", uchemo shennitbaer bemakom acher, ella kidfershu battikkunim: "ezehu chasid – hammitchassed im kono"; im kan dileh, leyaychada kudesha berich hu ushechinteh battachtonim, uchemo shekkatuv beraya mehemna parashat tetze: "kivra deishtaddel batar avoy veimmeh, derachim lon yattir miggarmeh venafsheh verucheh venishmeteh kulei, umasar garmeh lemita alayyhu lemifrak lon kulei", uchemo shennitbaer bemakom acher.

[Ushenehem olim bekane echad, ki al yede habberurim shemmevarrim minnoga maalim "mayyin nukevin", venaasim yichudim elyonim lehorid "mayyin dechurin", shehem hem meme hachasadim shebbechol mitzva umitzva meramach mitzvot ase, shekkullan hen bechinat chasadim umayyin dechurin", dehayynu, hameshachat kedushshat elohuto yitbarech milmala lematta lehitlabbesh battachtonim, kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher]:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 11: Veze leummat ze, rasha vetov lo leummat tzaddik vera lo.
Dehayynu, shehattov shebbenafsho haelohit shebbemocho uvechalal hayemani shebbelibbo, kafuf uvatel legabbe hara mehakkelippa shebbechalal hassemali.
Veze mitchallek gam ken lerivvot madregot chalukot, beinyan kammut veechut habbittul uchefifat hattov lara chas veshalom.

Yesh mi shehakkefifa vehabbittul etzlo meat mizzeer, veaf gam zot eno bitmidut, velo tadir lifrakim kerovim, ella leittim rechokim mitgabber hara al hattov, vechovesh et hair ketanna hu hagguf, ach lo chull‏vo ella miktzato levad, sheyyihye sar lemishmato, venaase lo merkava ulevush, lehitlabbesh bo echad mishshelosha levusheha hannizkarim leel. dehayynu, o bemaase levad, laasot averot kallot velo chamurot chas veshalom; o bedibbur levad, ledabber avak lashon hara veletzanut uchehay gavvna; o bemachashava levad, hirhure avera hakkashim meavera. vegam im eno mehareher baavera laasotah ella beinyan ziuug zachar unekeva baolam, sheover al azharat hattora: "venishmarta mikkol davar ra" – "shello yeharher bayyom kulei"; o shehi sheat hakkosher laasok battora vehu mefanne libbo levattala, keditnan beavot: "hanneor ballayla kulei umefanne libbo kulei" shebbeachat mikkol elle vechayyotze vahen nikra "rasha" baet hahi, shehara shebbenafsho gover bo umitlabbesh begufo umachatio umetammeo.

Veachar kach gover bo hattov shebbenafsho haelokit, umitcharet umevakkesh mechila uselicha meAdonai, vaAdonai yislach lo, im shav bitshuva haruya al pi atzat chachamenu-zichronam-livracha bishlosha chilluke chappara shehaya rabbi yishmael doresh kulei, kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher.

Veyesh mi shehara gover bo yoter, umitlabbeshim bo kol shelosha levushim shel hara, umachatio baaverot chamurot yoter, uveittim kerovim yoter. ach bentayim mitcharet, uvaim lo hirhure teshuva mibbechinat hattov shebbenafsho, shemmitgabber ketzat bentayim, ella sheen lo hitgabberut kol kach lenatztzeach et hara lifrosh mechataav legamre lihyot "mode veozev". veal ze amru rabbotenu zichronam livracha: "reshaim meleim charatot", shehem rov harshaim, sheyyesh bechinat tov benafsham adayin.

Ach mi sheeno mitcharet leolam, veen baim lo hirhure teshuva kelal – nikra "rasha vera lo", shehara shebbenafsho hu levaddo nishar bekirbo, ki gavar kol kach al hattov ad shennistallek mikkirbo veomed bivchinat makkif alav milmala.
Velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "akkol be asara shechinta sharya":
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 12: Vehabbenoni, hu shelleolam en hara gover kol kach lichbosh et hair ketanna lehitlabbesh bagguf lehachatio; dehayynu, sheshshelosha levushe nefesh habbahamit, shehem machashava dibbur umaase shemmitztzad hakkelippa, en govrim bo al nefesh haelohit lehitlabbesh bagguf – bammoach uvappe uvishar ramach evarim, lehachatiam uletammeam chas veshalom.

Rak shelosha levushe nefesh haelohit hem levaddam mitlabbeshim bagguf, shehem machashava dibbur umaase shel taryag mitzvot hattora, velo avar avera miyyamav velo yaavor leolam, velo nikra alav shem "rasha" afilu shaa achat verega echad kol yamav.

Ach mahut veatzmut nefesh haelohit, shehen eser bechinoteha, lo lahen levaddan hammelucha vehammemshala bair ketanna, ki im beittim mezummanim, kemo bishat keriat shema utefilla shehi sheat mochin degadlut lemala, vegam lematta hi sheat hakkosher lechol adam, sheaz mekashsher chachma-bina-daat shello laAdonai – lehaamik dato bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu, uleorer et haahava kerishpe esh bechalal hayemani shebbelibbo, ledavka vo bekiyyum hattora umitzvoteha meahava, shezzehu inyan hamevoar bikriat shema deorayyta, uvirchoteha shellefaneha uleachareha shehen midderabbanan – hen hachana lekiyyum hakkeriat-shema, kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher; veaz, hara shebbechalal hassemali kafuf uvatel lattov hammitpashshet bechalal hayemani mechachma-bina-daat shebbammoach hamekushsharim bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu.
Aval achar hattefilla, behistallekut hammochin degadlut en-sof baruch-hu, hare hara chozer veneor bechalal hassemali, umitavve taava letaavot olam hazze vetaanugav.

Rak mippene shello lo levaddo mishpat hammelucha vehammemshala bair, eno yachol lehotzi taavato mikkoach el happoal, lehitlabbesh beevre hagguf bemaase dibbur umachashava mammash, lehaamik machashavto betaanuge olam hazze ech lemallot taavat libbo, ki hammoach shallit al hallev [kemo shekkatuv beraya mehemna parashat pinchas] betoladto veteva yetzirato, shekkach notzar haadam betoladto, shekkol adam yachol birtzono shebbemocho lehitappek velimshol beruach taavato shebbelibbo, shello lemallot mishalot libbo bemaase dibbur umachashava, ulehassiach dato legamre mittaavot libbo el hahefech legamre, uvifrat el tzad hakkedushsha.

Kedichtiv: "veraiti sheyyesh yitron lachachma min hassichlut, kitron haor min hachoshech"; perush, kemo shehaor yesh lo yitron ushelita umemshala al hachoshech, shemmeat or gashmi doche harebe min hachshech, shennidche mimmennu meelav umimmela, kach nidche mimmela sichlut harebe shel hakkelippa vesitra ochora shebbechalal hassemali [kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "ella im ken nichnas bo ruach shetut vechulei"], mippene hachachma shebbannefesh haelohit shebbammoach, asher retzonah limshol levaddah bair, ulehitlabbesh bishlosha levusheha hannizkarim leel, bechol hagguf kullo kannizkar leel, shehem machashava dibbur umaase shel taryag mitzvot hattora, kannizkar leel.

Veaf-al-pi-chen eno nikra "tzaddik" kelal, mippene sheyyitron hazze asher leor nefesh haelohit al hachoshech vesichlut shel hakkelippa hannidche mimmela – eno ella bishlosha levusheha hannizkarim leel, velo bemahutah veatzmutah al mahutah veatzmutah shel hakkelippa, ki mahutah veatzmutah shel nefesh habbahamit shemmehakkelippa shebbechalal hassemali – lo nidcha kelal mimmekomo babbenoni achar hattefilla, sheen rishpe esh ahavat Adonai behitgallut libbo bechalal hayemani, ki im tocho ratzuf "ahava mesutteret", shehi ahava hattivit shebbannefesh haelohit, kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman.

Vaazay, yachol lihyot sichlut hakkesil hara behitgallut libbo bechalal hassemali, lehitavvot taava lechol inyeyne gashmiyyut olam hazze, ben behetter ben beissur chas veshalom, keillu lo hitpallel kelal.

Ella shebbidvar issur eno ole bedato laasot haissur befoal mammash chas veshalom, ella hirhure avera hakkashim meavera yecholim lifol laalot lemocho ulevalbelo mittora vaavoda, uchemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "3 averot en adam nitztzol mehen bechol yom, hirhur avera veiyyun tefilla kulei".

Rak shellaze moil harshimu bammochin, veyirat Adonai veahavato hamesutteret bechalal hayemani, lehitgabber velishlot al hara hazze hammitavve taava, shello lihyot lo shelita umemshala bair lehotzi taavato mikkoach el happoal lehitlabbesh beevre hagguf.

Vaafilu bammoach levaddo, lehareher bera, en lo shelita umemshala lehareher chas veshalom birtzono shebbemocho – sheyyekabbel beratzon chas veshalom hirhur ze hara haole meelav mehallev lammoach kannizkar leel, ella miyyad baaliyyayto lesham, dochehu bishte yadayim, umassiach dato miyyad shennizkar shehu hirhur ra, veeno mekabbelo beratzon afilu lehareher bo beratzon, vechol shekken lehaaloto al haddaat laasoto chas veshalom, o afilu ledabber bo, ki hameharher beratzon nikra rasha beotah shaa, vehabbenoni eno rasha afilu shaa achat leolam.
Vechen bidvarim shebben adam lachavero, miyyad sheole lo mehallev lammoach ezo tina vesina chas veshalom, o ezo kina o kaas o kefeda vedomehen, eno mekabbelan kelal bemocho uvirtzono.

Veadderabba, hammoach shallit umoshel baruach shebbelibbo laasot hahefech mammash, – lehitnaheg im chavero bemiddat chesed, vechibba yetera mudaat lo, lisbol mimmennu ad katze haacharon, velo lichos chas veshalom, – vegam, shello leshallem lo kefoolo chas veshalom, – ella adderabba; ligmol lechayyayvim tovot, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar, lilmod miyyosef im echav:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 13: Uvaze yuvan leshon maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "benonim ze vaze shoftan" [perush, yetzer tov veyetzer hara], dichtiv: "ki yaamod limin evyon lehoshia mishshofte nafsho", velo amru "ze vaze moshlim" chas veshalom, ki kesheyyesh ezo shelita umemshala layyetzer hara bair ketanna", afilu lefi shaa kalla – nikra rasha beotah shaa.

Ella, hayyetzer hara eno – rak al derech mashal kemo shofet vedayyayn haomer dato bammishpat, veaf-al-pi-chen, yachol lihyot shello yihye pesak halacha kach lemaase, mippene sheyyesh od shofet vedayyayn hacholek alav, vetzarich lehacheria benehem, vahalacha kedivre hammachria.

Kach, hayyetzer hara omer dato bechalal hassemali shebballev, umehallev ole lammoach lehareher bo, umiyyad cholek alav hashshofet hashsheni shehu hannefesh haelohit shebbammoach, hammitpashshet bechalal hayemani shebballev – mekom mishkan hayyetzer tov, vahalacha kedivre hammachria, hu hakkadosh-baruch-hu – haozro lehayyetzer tov, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "ilmale hakkadosh-baruch-hu ozro en yachol lo".
Vehaezer, hi haheara shemmeir or Adonai al nefesh haelohit, lihyot lah yitron ushelita al sichlut hakkesil veyetzer hara, keyitron haor min hachoshech, kannizkar leel.

Ach meachar shehara shebbechalal hassemali babbenoni hu betakpo ketoladto, lehitavvot taava lechol taanuge olam hazze, velo nitbattel bemiut legabbe hattov velo nidcha mimmekomo kelal, rak sheen lo shelita umemshala lehitpashshet beevre hagguf, – mippene hakkadosh-baruch-hu haomed limin evyon veozer umeir lannefesh haelohit – lachen nikra – "kerasha", – kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "afilu kol haolam kullo omrim lecha tzaddik atta – heye veenecha kerasha", velo rasha mammash, – ella sheyyachazik atzmo levenoni, velo lehaamin lehaolam sheomrim shehara shebbo nitbattel legabbe hattov, shezzo madregat tzaddik, – ella yihye veenav keillu mahuto veatzmuto shel hara hu betakpo uvigvurato bechalal hassemali ketoladto, velo chalaf vehalach mimmennu meuma, veadderabba – nitchazzek yoter behemshech hazzeman, shennishtammesh bo harebe baachila ushetiyya ushear inyeyne olam hazze.

Veaf mi shebbetorat Adonai cheftzo veyehge vah yomam valayla lishmah, en zo hochacha kelal shennidcha hara mimmekomo, ella yachol lihyot, shemmahuto veatzmuto hu betakpo uvigvurato bimkomo bechalal hassemali, rak shellevushav, shehem machashava dibbur umaase shel nefesh habbahamit – enan mitlabbeshim bammoach vehappe vehayyadayim ushear evre hagguf, mippene Adonai shennatan shelita umemshala lammoach al hallev, velachen nefesh haelohit shebbammoach moshelet bair ketanna", evre hagguf kullam, sheyyihyu levush umerkava lishlosha levusheha sheyyitlabbeshu bahem, shehem machashava dibbur umaase shel taryag mitzvot hattora.

Aval mahutah veatzmutah shel nefesh haelohit, en lah shelita umemshala al mahutah veatzmutah shel nefesh habbahamit babbenoni, ki im, beshaa sheahavat Adonai hu behitgallut libbo beittim mezummanim, kemo bishat hattefilla vechayyotze vah, veaf gam zot happaam, enah rak shelita umemshala levad, kedichtiv: "uleom milom yeematz" – "keshezze kam ze nofel, ucheshezze kam kulei", shennefesh haelohit mitammetzet umitgabberet al nefesh habbahamit, bimkor haggevurot shehi bina, lehitbonen bigdullat Adonai en-sof baruch-hu uleholid ahava azza laAdonai kerishpe esh bechalal hayemani shebbelibbo, veaz – itkafya sitra ochora shebbechalal hassemali.
Aval lo nitbattel legamre babbenoni, ella batztzaddik, shenneemar bo: "velibbi chalal bekirbi", vehu moes bera vesono betachlit hassina vehammius, o shello betachlit hassina, kannizkar leel.

Aval babbenoni, hu derech mashal keadam sheyyashen, sheyyachol lachazor veleor mishshenato, kach hara babbenoni, hu keyashen bechalal hassemali bishat keriat shema utefilla, shellibbo boer beahavat Adonai, veachar kach, yachol lihyot chozer veneor.

Velachen haya rabba machazik atzmo kevenoni, af dela fasik pumeh miggirsa uvetorat Adonai cheftzo yomam valayla, bachafitza vachashika uteshuka venefesh shokeka laAdonai beahava rabba kevishat keriat shema utefilla, venidme veenav kevenoni hammitpallel kol hayyom, uchemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "halevay sheyyitpallel adam kol hayyom kullo".

Vehinne, middat ahava zo, haamura bevenonim, bishat hattefilla, al yede hitgabberut hannefesh haelohit kulei, hinne legabbe madregat hatztzaddikim ovde Adonai beemet laamitto, en bechinat ahava zo nikret beshem "avodat emet" kelal, meachar shecholefet veoveret achar hattefilla, uchetiv: "sefat emet tikkon laad, vead argia leshon shaker".

Veaf-al-pi-chen, legabbe madregat habbenonim – nikret "avoda tamma" beemet laamitto shellahem, ish ish kefi madregato bemadregat habbenonim, vahareni kore beahavatam shebbitfillatam gam ken "sefat emet tikkon laad", hoil uvechoach nafsham haelohit lachazor uleorer bechinat ahava zo leolam, behitgabberutah bishat hattefilla midde yom beyom, al yede hachana haruya lechol nefesh kefi erkah umadregatah.

Ki hinne, middat emet hi middato shel yaakov, hannikra: "beriach hattichon hammavriach min hakkatze el hakkatze" – merum hammaalot umadregot ad sof kol dargin, uvechol maala umadrega mavriach toch nekudda haemtzait, shehi nekuddat uvechinat middat emet shellah.

Umiddat emet hi "nachala beli metzarim", veen lah shiur lemala ad rum hammaalot, vechol maalot umadregot shellematta, hem keayin legabbe maalot umadregot shellemala mehen [kayyadua leyode chen, shebbechinat rosh umochin shel madregot tachtonot hen lematta mibbechinat akevayim veragle madregot elyonot mehen, uchemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "ragle hachayyot keneged kullan"]:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 14: Vehinne, middat habbenoni, hi middat kol adam veachareha kol adam yimshoch, shekkol adam yachol lihyot benoni bechol et uvechol shaa. ki, habbenoni eno moes bera, shezzehu davar hammasur lallev velo kol haittim shavot, ela "sur mera vaase tov", dehayynu befoal mammash, bemaase dibbur umachashava, shebbahem habbechira vehayecholet veharshut netuna lechol adam laasot uledabber velachashov gam ma shehu neged taavat libbo vehefkah mammash, ki gam beshaa shehallev chomed umitavve ezo taava gashmiyyit behetter o beissur chas veshalom, yachol lehitgabber ulehassiach dato mimmenna legamre, beamro lelibbo: enenni rotze lihyot rasha afilu shaa achat, ki enenni rotze lihyot muvedal venifrad chas veshalom meAdonai echad beshum ofen, kedichtiv: "avonotechem mavdilim vegomer", rak ani rotze ledavka vo nafshi ruchi venishmati, behitlabbeshan bishlosha levushav yitbarech, shehem: maase dibbur umachashava baAdonai vetorato umitzvotav, meahava mesutteret shebbelibbi laAdonai, kemo belev kelalut yisrael shennikreu "ohave shemecha", vaafilu kal shebbekallim yachol limsor nafsho al kedushshat Adonai, velo nofel anochi mimmennu bevadday, ella shennichnas bo ruach shetut, venidme lo shebbaavera zo odennu beyahaduto veen nishmato muvedelet meelohe yisrael, vegam, shocheach ahavato laAdonai hamesutteret belibbo, aval ani, enenni rotze lihyot shote kamohu lichpor haemet.

Ma sheen ken bedavar hammasur lallev, dehayynu, sheyyehe hara maus mammash ballev vesanuy betachlit sina – o afilu shello betachlit sina – hinne ze, i efshar sheyyihye beemet laamitto, ella al yede godel vetokef haahava laAdonai, bivchinat "ahava betaanugim", lehitanneg al Adonai meen olam habba, veal ze amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "olamcha tire bechayyecha kulei"; veen kol adam zoche laze, ki zehu keen kibbul sachar, uchedichtiv: "avodat mattana etten et kehunnatchem vegomer", kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher.

Velachen amar iyyov: "barata tzaddikim kulei"; vechidita battikkunim, sheyyesh benishmot yisrael kamma mine madregot uvechinot: chasidim, gibborim hammitgabberim al yitzram, mare tora, neviim kulei, tzaddikim kulei, ayyen sham:
Uvaze yuvan kefel leshon hashshevua: "tehi tzaddik, veal tehi rasha"; delichora tamuah, ki meachar shemmashbiim oto "tehi tzaddik", lamma tzerichim lehashebio od shello yihye rasha?

Ella, mishshum sheen kol adam zoche lihyot tzaddik, veen laadam mishpat habbechira baze kol kach, lehitanneg al Adonai beemet, vesheyyihye hara maus mammash beemet, velachen mashbiim shenit "al tehi rasha" al kol panim, shebbaze – mishpat habbechira veharshut netuna lechol adam limshol beruach taavato shebbelibbo velichbosh yitzro, shello yihye rasha afilu shaa achat kol yamav, ben bivchinat "sur mera", ben bivchinat "vaase tov", – veen tov ella tora", dehayynu talmud tora shekkeneged kullan.

Ach af-al-pi-chen, tzarich likboa lo ittim gam ken lashit etzot benafsho lihyot moes bera, kegon, baatzat chachamenu-zichronam-livracha: "ishsha – chemet melea tzoa kulei", uchehay gavvna, vechen kol mine matammim umaadannim naasim kach: chemet male kulei; vechen kol taanuge olam hazze, hechacham roe hannolad mehen, shessofan lirkov velihyot rimma veashpa.

Vehahefech, lehitanneg velismoach baAdonai – al yede hitbonnut bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu kefi yecholto, af sheyyodea benafsho shello yaggia lemadrega zo beemet laamitto – ki im bedimyonot – af-al-pi-chen, hu yaase et shello, lekayyem et hashshevua shemmashbiim "tehi tzaddik", vaAdonai yaase hattov beenav.

Veod, shehahergel al kol davar – shilton, venaase teva sheni, uchesheyyargil lemaes et hara – yihye nimas ketzat beemet, uchesheyyargil lesammeach nafsho baAdonai al yede hitbonnut bigdullat Adonai, hare beitaruta diltatta itaruta dilella, vechulle hay veulay yeare alav ruach mimmarom, veyizke livchinat ruach mishshoresh eze tzaddik shettitabber bo – laavod Adonai besimcha amittit, kedichtiv: "simchu tzaddikim baAdonai", vetitkayyem bo beemet hashshevua shemmashbiim: "tehi tzaddik":
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 15: Uvaze yuvan ma shekkatuv: "veshavtem ureitem ben tzaddik lerasha, ben oved elohim laasher lo avado".

Shehahefresh ben "oved elohim" letzaddik" hu, sheoved" hu leshon hove – shehu beemtza haavoda, shehi hammilchama im hayyetzer hara, lehitgabber alav ulegarsho mehair ketanna" shello yitlabbesh beevre hagguf, shehu beemet avoda veamal gadol lehillachem bo tamid, vehayeynu – habbenoni.

Aval hatztzaddik, nikra "eved Adonai" – beshem hattoar, kemo shem chacham o melech, shekkevar naasa chacham o melech, kach ze, kevar avad vegamar legamre avodat hammilchama im hara, ad ki vaygarshehu vayyelech lo, velibbo chalal bekirbo.

Uvabbenoni yesh gam ken shete madregot: "oved elohim", vaasher lo avado", veaf-al-pi-chen – eno rasha, ki lo avar miyyamav shum avera kalla, vegam kiyyem kol hammitzvot sheefshar lo lekayyeyman, vetalmud tora keneged kullam, vela fasik pumeh miggirsa.

Ella sheeno ose shum milchama im hayyetzer lenatztzecho, al yede or Adonai hammeir al nefesh haelohit shebbammoach hashshallit al hallev kannizkar leel, mippene sheen yitzro omed lenegdo kelal levattelo mittorato vaavodato, veen tzarich lilchom immo kelal, kegon shehu matmid belimmudo betivo mittoladto al yede tigboret hammara shechora", vechen en lo milchama mittaavat nashim mippene shehu metzunnan betivo, vechen bishar taanuge olam hazze – hu mechussar hergesh hanaa betivo.

Velachen, en tzarich lehitbonen kol kach bigdullat Adonai, leholid mibbinato ruach daat veyirat Adonai bemocho – lehishshamer shello laavor al mitzvot lo taase, veahavat Adonai belibbo – ledavka vo bekiyyum hammitzvot, vetalmud tora keneged kullan, ella day lo beahava mesutteret asher belev kelalut yisrael, shennikreu "ohave shemo".
Velachen eno nikra "oved" kelal, ki ahava zo hamesutteret, enah peullato vaavodato kelal, ella hi yerushshatenu meavotenu lichlal yisrael, uchemo sheyyitbaer lekamman.
Vechen af mi sheeno matmid belimmudo betivo, rak shehirgil atzmo lilmod behatemada gedola, venaasa hahergel lo teva sheni, day lo beahava mesutteret zo, ella im ken rotze lilmod yoter mergiluto.
Uvaze yuvan ma shekkatuv baggemara, deoved elohim" – hayeynu mi sheshshone pirko mea feamim veechad, velo avado" – hayeynu mi sheshshone pirko mea feamim levad.

Vehayeynu, mishshum shebbimehem haya hargilut lishnot kol perek mea feamim, kidita hatam baggemara mashal mishshuk shel chammarim shenniskarim leeser parse bezuza uleachad asar parse bitre zuze, mippene shehu yoter mergilutam, velachen, zot happaam hammea veachat, hayetera al hargilut shehuregal minneurav – shekula keneged kullan, veola al gabbehen beyeter seet veyeter oz, lihyot nikra "oved elohim"; mippene shekkede leshannot teva hargilut, tzarich leorer et haahava laAdonai al yede shemmitbonen bigdullat Adonai bemocho, lishlot al hatteva shebbechalal hassemali hammale dam hannefesh habbahamit shemmehakkelippa, shemmimmenna hu hatteva, vezo hi avoda tamma labbenoni.

O leorer et haahava hamesutteret shebbelibbo, limshol al yadah al hatteva shebbechalal hassemali, shezzo nikra gam ken avoda, lehillachem im hatteva vehayyetzer, al yede shemmeorer haahava hamesutteret belibbo.
Ma sheen ken kesheen lo milchama kelal, en ahava zo mitztzad atzmah nikret avodato kelal:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 16: Veze kelal gadol baavodat Adonai labbenonim: haikkar, hu limshol velishlot al hatteva shebbechalal hassemali al yede or Adonai hammeir lannefesh haelohit shebbammoach, velishlot al hallev.

Keshemmitbonen bemocho bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu, leholid mibbinato ruach daat veyirat Adonai bemocho – lihyot "sur mera" deorayyta uderabbanan, vaafilu issur kal shel divrehem chas veshalom, veahavat Adonai belibbo bechalal hayemani – bachashika vachafitza ledavka vo bekiyyum hammitzvot deorayyta uderabbanan, vetalmud tora shekkeneged kullan.

Veyeter al ken, tzarich leda kelal gadol baavoda labbenonim, sheggam im en yad sichlo veruach binato masseget leholid ahavat Adonai behitgallut libbo, sheyyihye libbo boer kerishpe esh vechafetz bachafitza vachashika uteshuka muregeshet ballev ledavka vo, rak haahava mesutteret bemocho vetaalumot libbo,

Haggaha
vehassibba laze hi, mippene heyot hammochin shello venefesh-ruach-neshama shello mibbechinat ﬠybur veheﬠlem toch hattevuna, velo mibbechinat leda vehitgallut, kayyaduﬠ leyodﬠy chen:

Dehayynu shehallev mevin beruach chachma uvina shebbemocho gedullat en-sof baruch-hu, dechulla kammeh kela chashiv mammash, asher al ken, yaata lo yitbarech shettichle elav nefesh kol chay liddavek ulehikkalel beoro; vegam nafsho verucho asher bekirbo kach yaata lahen lihyot kalot elav bachashika vachafitza, latzet minartekan, hu hagguf, ledavka vo, rak shebbeal karchan chayot henna betoch hagguf utzerurot bo kealmanot chayyot; velet machashava dilhon tefisa veh kelal, ki im kaasher tefisa umitlabbeshet battora uvemitzvoteha, kimshal hamechabbek et hammelech hannizkar leel; vee lazot, yaata lahen lechabbeko bechol lev venefesh umeod, dehayynu, kiyyum hattaryag mitzvot bemaase uvedibbur uvemachashava, shehi hassagat vidiat hattora kannizkar leel.

Hinne, keshemmaamik beinyan ze betaalumot tevunot libbo umocho, ufiv velibbo shavin, shemmekayyem ken befiv kefi asher nigmar bitvunat libbo umocho, dehayynu, lihyot betorat Adonai cheftzo veyehge vah yomam valayla befiv, vechen hayyadayim ushear evarim mekayyeymim hammitzvot kefi ma shennigmar bitvunat libbo umocho, hare tevuna zo mitlabbeshet bemaase dibbur umachashevet hattora umitzvoteha, lihyot lahem bechinat mochin vechayyut vegadfin lefarcha leela, keillu asak bahem bidchilu urechimu mammash asher behitgallut libbo [bachafitza vachashika uteshuka muregeshet belibbo venafsho hatztzemea laAdonai, mippene rishpe esh ahavato shebbelibbo, kannizkar leel], hoil utevuna zo shebbemocho vetaalumot libbo hi hammeviato laasok bahem, velule shehaya mitbonen bitvuna zo lo haya osek bahem kelal, ella betzarche gufo levad [vegam im hu matmid belimmudo betivo, af-al-pi-chen, ohev et gufo yoter betivo].

Veze ramzu rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha beamram: "machashava tova hakkadosh-baruch-hu metzarfah lemaase", vahava-leh-lememar: "maale alav hakkatuv keillu asaah", ella hainyan, ki dechilu urechimu shebbehitgallut libbo, hem hammitlabbeshim bemaase hammitzvot lehachayotam lefarcha leela, ki hallev hu gam ken chumeri, kishar evarim shehem kele hammaase, ella shehu penimi vechayyut lahem, velachen yachol lehitlabbesh bahem lihyot lahem gadfin lehaalotam.

Ach haddechilu urechimu shebbitvunot mocho vetaalumot libbo hannizkarot leel – gavhu darchehem lemala mala mibbechinat hammaase, vei efshar lahem lehitlabbesh bivchinat maase hammitzvot lihyot lahem bechinat mochin vechayyut lehaalotan lefarcha leela, im lo shehakkadosh-baruch-hu metzarfan umechabberan livchinat hammaase; vehen nikraot beshem "machashava tova", ki enan dechilu urechimu mammash behitgallut libbo, ki im bitvunat mocho vetaalumot libbo kannizkar leel.

Haggaha
uchemo shekkatuv bazzohar vﬠtz chayim, ditvuna" otiyyot "ben uvat", shehen dechilu urechimu, velifﬠmim hattevuna yoredet lihyot mochin benukeva" dizﬠyr anpin", shehen otiyyot hattora vehammitzvot. vehammaskil yavin:

Ach tzeruf ze metzaref hakkadosh-baruch-hu, kede lehaalot maase hammitzvot veesek hattora hannaasim al yede "machashava tova" hannizkeret leel, ad olam habberia, mekom aliyyayt hattora vehammitzvot hannaasim al yede dechilu urechimu sichliyyim asher behitgallut libbo mammash.
Aval belav hache, name olim leolam hayetzira, al yede dechilu urechimu tiviyyim hamesuttarim belev kol yisrael betoldotam, kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman baarichut:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 17: Uvaze yuvan ma shekkatuv: "ki karov elecha haddavar meod, beficha uvilvavcha laasoto".

Delichora, hu – "bilvavcha" – neged hachush shellanu [vehattora hi nitzchit], sheen karov meod haddavar lehappech libbo mittaavot olam hazze leahavat Adonai beemet, uchemo shekkatuv baggemara: "atu yira milleta zutarti hi"? vechol shekken ahava. vegam amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha detzaddikim – davka – libbam birshutam".

Ella, delaasoto" – rotze lomar, haahava hammevia lide asiyyayt hammitzvot bilvad, shehi "reuta delibba" shebbetaalumot lev, gam ki enah behitgallut libbo kerishpe esh, vedavar ze "karov meod" venakel lechol adam asher yesh lo moach bekadkodo, ki mocho birshuto veyachol lehitbonen bo kechol asher yachpotz, uchesheyyitbonen bo bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu, mimmela yolid, bemocho al kol panim – haahava laAdonai ledavka vo bekiyyum mitzvotav vetorato.
Veze kol haadam", ki – "hayyom laasotam" ketiv, shehayyom" hu olam hammaase davka "ulemachar kulei", kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher.

Vehammoach – shallit betivo vetoladto al chalal hassemali shebballev, veal piv, veal kol haevarim shehem kele hammaase. im lo mi shehu rasha beemet, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha sheharshaim hem birshut libbam", veen libbam birshutam kelal, veze onesh al godel veotzem avonam. velo dibbera tora bemetim ellu, shebbechayyehem keruyim metim.

Ki beemet, i efshar larshaim lehatechil laavod Adonai beli sheyyaasu teshuva al heavar techilla – leshabber hakkelippot shehem masach mavdil umechitza shel barzel hammafseket benam laavihem shebbashshamayim, al yede shevirat libbo umerirat nafsho al chataav, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar al pasuk: "zivche elohim ruach nishbara, lev nishbar vegomer", sheal yede lev nishbar – nishbara ruach hattumea desitra ochora [ayyen sham parashat pinchas daf 240 ufarashat vayyikra daf 8 vedaf Adonai ammud 1 uveferush harav moshe zakkut sham].

Vehi bechinat teshuva tattaa, lehaalot hei tattaa, lahakimah minnefilatah shenafla el hachitzonim, shehu sod galut hashshechina, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "galu leedom – shechina immahem", dehayynu, kesheadam ose maase edom morid umamshich lesham bechinat venitzotz elohut hamechayye et nefesh-ruach-neshama shello, hamelubbashim bo bannefesh habbahamit mehakkelippa, shebbelibbo shebbechalal hassemali, hammolechet bo beodo rasha umoshelet bair ketanna shello, venefesh-ruach-neshama kevushim baggola etzlah.
Ucheshennishbar libbo bekirbo, venishbera ruach hattumea vesitra ochora, veyitpardu kulei – hi kama minnefilatah vegam nitztzava, kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 18: Uletosefet beur, baer hetev, millat "meod" shebbappasuk: "ki karov elecha haddavar meod vegomer".

Tzarich leda neemana, ki af mi sheddato ketzara bidiat Adonai, veen lo lev lehavin bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu, leholid mimmenna dechilu urechimu afilu bemocho utevunato levad, af-al-pi-chen, karov elav haddavar meod lishmor velaasot kol mitzvot hattora vetalmud tora keneged kullan, befiv uvilvavo mammash, meumeka delibba, beemet laamitto, bidchilu urechimu, shehi "ahava mesutteret" shebbelev kelalut yisrael, shehi yerushsha lanu meavotenu.
Rak shetztzarich levaer ulehakdim techilla baer hetev, shoresh ahava zo, veinyaynah, veech hi yerushsha lanu, veech nichlal bah gam dechilu.

Vehainyan, ki haavot – hen hen hammerkava, veal ken zachu lehameshich nefesh-ruach-neshama livnehem acharehem ad olam meeser sefirot dikdushsha shebbearba olamot atzilut-beria-yetzira-asiyya, lechol echad veechad kefi madregato uchefi maasav.
Veal kol panim, afilu lekal shebbekallim ufoshe yisrael nimshach beziuugam nefesh denefesh demalchut daasiyya, shehi madrega hattachtona shebbikdushshat haasiyya.

Veaf-al-pi-chen, meachar shehi meeser sefirot kedoshot, hi kelula mikkullan, gam mechachma daasiyya, shebbetochah melubbeshet chachma demalchut daatzilut, shebbetochah chachma daatzilut, shebbah meir or-en-sof baruch-hu mammash, kedichtiv: "Adonai bechachma yasad aretz", vekullam bechachma asita".

Venimtza, ki en-sof baruch-hu melubbash bivchinat chachma shebbenefesh haadam – yihye mi sheyyihye miyyisrael, uvechinat hachachma shebbah, im or-en-sof baruch-hu hamelubbash bah, mitpashshetet bechol bechinot hannefesh kullah, lehachayotah mibbechinat roshah ad bechinat raglah, kedichtiv: "hachachma techayye vealeha".
[Velifamim mamshichim poshe yisrael neshamot gevohot meod shehayu beimke hakkelippot, kemo shekkatuv besefer gilgulim]:
Hinne, hachachma hi mekor hassechel vehahavana, vehi lemala mehabbina shehu havanat hassechel vehassagato, vehachachma – hi lemala mehahavana vehahassaga, vehi makor lahen.
Vezehu leshon chachma – "koach ma", shehu ma sheeno mussag umuvan, veeno nitpas behassaga adayin, velachen mitlabbesh bah or-en-sof baruch-hu delet machashava tefisa veh kelal.

Velachen, kol yisrael, afilu hannashim veamme haaretz, hem maaminim baAdonai, shehaemuna hi lemala min haddaat vehahassaga, ki "peti yaamin lechol davar, vearum yavin vegomer", ulegabbe hakkadosh-baruch-hu, shehu lemala min hassechel vehaddaat velet machashava tefisa veh kelal – hakkol kiftayim etzlo yitbarech, kedichtiv: "vaani vaar velo eda, behemot hayiti immach, vaani tamid immach vegomer", kelomar, shebbaze sheani "baar" uvehemot" – "ani tamid immach".
Velachen, afilu kal shebbekallim ufoshe yisrael mosrim nafsham al kedushshat Adonai, al harov, vesovlim innuyim kashim shello lichpor baAdonai echad.
