Veaf im hem burim veamme haaretz veen yodim gedullat Adonai, vegam bamat sheyyodim en mitbonnim kelal, veen mosrim nafsham mechamat daat vehitbonnut baAdonai kelal, ella beli shum daat vehitbonnut, rak keillu hu davar shei efshar kelal lichpor baAdonai echad, beli shum taam vetaana umaane kelal.
Vehayeynu, mishshum she echad meir umechayye kol hannefesh, al yede hitlabbeshuto bivchinat chachma shebbah, shehi lemala min haddaat vehassechel hammussag umuvan:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 19: Uletosefet beur, tzarich levaer hetev ma shekkatuv: "ner Adonai nishmat adam".

Perush, sheyyisrael hakkeruyim "adam", nishmatam hi, lemashal, keor hanner shemmitnanea tamid lemala betivo, mippene sheor haesh chafetz beteva, lippared mehappetila veliddavek besharsho lemala bisod haesh hakkelali shettachat galgal hayyareach, kemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim.
Veaf sheal yede ze yichbe velo yair kelum lematta, vegam lemala – besharsho, yitbattel oro bimtziut besharsho, af-al-pi-chen, bechach hu chafetz betivo.

Kach nishmat haadam", vechen bechinat ruach vanefesh, cheftzah vecheshkah betivah lippared velatzet min hagguf veliddavek besharshah umekorah – baAdonai chayye hachayyim baruch-hu; hagam shettihye ayin vaefes vetitbattel sham bimtziut legamre, velo yishshaer mimmenna meuma mimmahutah veatzmutah harishon, af-al-pi-chen, ze retzonah vecheftzah betivah.
Veteva ze hu shem hammusheal lechol davar sheeno bivchinat taam vadaat.

Vegam kan, hakkavvavna, sheratzon vechefetz ze bannefesh eno bivchinat taam vadaat vesechel mussag umuvan, ella lemala mehaddaat vesechel hammussag vehammuvan, vehi bechinat chachma shebbannefesh shebbah or-en-sof baruch-hu.

Vezehu kelal bechol sitra dikdushsha, sheeno ella ma shennimshach mechachma, shennikra "kodesh haelyon", habbatel bimtziut beor-en-sof baruch-hu hamelubbash bo, veeno davar bifne atzmo kannizkar leel, velachen nikra "koach ma".

Vehu hefech mammash mibbechinat hakkelippa vesitra ochora, shemmimmenna nafshot ummot haolam deavdin legarmayyhu, veamrin: "hav hav" vehaleiteni", lihyot yesh vedavar bifne atzmo, kannizkar leel, hefech bechinat hachachma; velachen nikraim "metim", ki "hachachma techayye", uchetiv: "yamutu velo vechachma", vechen harshaim ufoshe yisrael kodem shebbau lide nissayon lekaddesh hashshem; ki bechinat hachachma shebbannefesh haelohit im nitzotz elohut meor-en-sof baruch-hu hamelubbash bah, hem bivchinat galut begufam bannefesh habbahamit, mitztzad hakkelippa shebbechalal hassemali shebballev, hammolechet umoshelet begufam besod galut hashshechina, kannizkar leel.

Velachen nikret ahava zo bannefesh haelohit, shertzonah vecheftzah liddavek baAdonai chayye hachayyim baruch-hu, beshem "ahava mesutteret", ki hi mesutteret umechussa bilvush sak diklippa befoshe yisrael, umimmenna nichnas bahem ruach shetut lachato, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "en adam chote kulei".

Ella sheggalut hazze livchinat chachma – eno ella labbechina hammitpashshetet mimmenna bannefesh kullah lehachayotah, aval shoresh veikkar shel bechinat chachma shebbannefesh haelohit hu bammochin, veenah mitlabbeshet bilvush sak diklippa shebballev bechalal hassemali bivchinat galut mammash, rak shehi bivchinat shena barshaim, veenah poelet peullatah bahem – kol zeman sheasukim bedatam uvinatam betaavot haolam.

Ach keshebbaim lide nissayon bidvar emuna, shehi lemala mehaddaat, venaga ad hannefesh – livchinat chachma shebbah, azay hi neora mishshenatah, ufoelet peullatah bechoach Adonai hamelubbash bah, uchemo shekkatuv: "vayyikatz keyashen Adonai", laamod bannissayon beemunat Adonai beli shum taam vadaat vesechel mussag lo, lehitgabber al hakkelippot vetaavot olam hazze behetter uveissur shehuregal bahem, velimos bahem, velivchor lo Adonai lechelko ulegoralo, limsor lo nafsho al kedushshat shemo.

Veaf ki hakkelippot gavru alav kol yamav velo yachol lahem, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha sheharshaim hem birshut libbam", mikkol makom, keshebba lide nissayon bidvar emuna baAdonai echad, sheyyesudatah beharere kodesh, hi bechinat chachma shebbannefesh haelohit, shebbah melubbash or-en-sof baruch-hu, hare kol hakkelippot betelim umevuttalim vehayu kelo hayu mammash lifne Adonai, kedichtiv: "kol haggoyim keayin negdo vegomer", uchetiv: "ki hinne oyvecha Adonai, ki hinne oyvecha yovedu, yitpardu vegomer", uchetiv: "kehimmes donag mippene esh yovdu vegomer", uchetiv: "harim kaddonag namassu".

Vehinne, or Adonai en-sof baruch-hu hamelubbash bachachma shebbannefesh – gadol veatzum kocho kol kach, legaresh velidchot hassitra ochora vehakkelippot shello yuchelu yiggeu afilu bilvushav, shehem machashava dibbur umaase shel emunat Adonai echad; dehayynu, laamod bannissayon, limsor nafsho afilu shello laasot rak eze maase levad neged emunat Adonai echad, kegon, lehishtachavot laavoda zara, af sheeno maamin bah kelal belibbo, vechen shello ledabber toa chas veshalom al achdut Adonai, af sheen piv velibbo shavin, rak libbo shalem beemunat Adonai.

Veze – nikra "dechilu hannichlal birchimu", shehi ahava hattivit shebbannefesh haelohit shebbichlalut yisrael, shecheftzah uretzonah betivah liddavek besharshah umekorah or-en-sof baruch-hu, shemmippene ahava zo veratzon ze, hi yerea umefachedet betivah minnegoa biktze tumeat avoda-zara chas-veshalom, shehi neged emunat Adonai echad, afilu bilvusheha hachitzonim shehem dibbur o maase, beli emuna ballev kelal:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 20: Vehinne mudaat zot lakkol, ki mitzvat veazharat avoda zara, shehem shene dibberot harishonim, "anochi" velo yihye lecha", hem kelalut kol hattora chullah; ki dibbur "anochi" – kolel kol ramach mitzvot ase, velo yihye lecha" – kolel kol shasa mitzvot lo taase, velachen shamanu "anochi" velo yihye lecha" levad mippi haggevura kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha, mippene shehem kelalut hattora chullah.

Ulevaer hetev inyan ze, tzarich lehazekir techilla biktzara inyan umahut achduto shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu, shennikra "yachid umeyuchad", "vechol maaminim shehu levaddo hu", kemo shehaya kodem shennivra haolam mammash, uchemo sheomrim: "atta hu ad shello nivra haolam, atta hu mishshennivra kulei", perush – "hu" mammash beli shum shinnuy, kedichtiv: "ani Adonai lo shaniti". ki, olam hazze vechen kol haolamot haelyonim – enam poalim shum shinnuy beachduto yitbarech behibbaram meayin leyesh.
Shekkemo shehaya hu levaddo hu yachid umeyuchad kodem hibbaram, ken hu levaddo hu yachid umeyuchad achar shebberaam, mishshum dechulla kammeh kela chashiv, ucheayin vaefes mammash.

Ki hithauut kol haolamot elyonim vetachtonim meayin leyesh, vechayyutam vekiyyumam hamekayyeymam shello yachzeru lihyot ayin vaefes keshehaya, eno ella devar Adonai veruach piv yitbarech hamelubbash bahem.

Ulemashal, kemo benefesh haadam, keshemmedabber dibbur echad; sheddibbur ze levaddo kela mammash, afilu legabbe kelalut nafsho hamedabberet, shehu bechinat levush haemtzai shellah, shehu koach haddibbur shellah, sheyyachol ledabber dibburim leen ketz vetachlit; vechol shekken legabbe bechinat levush happenimi shellah shehu hammachashava, shemmimmenna nimshechu haddibburim vehi chayyutam; veen tzarich lomar legabbe mahut veatzmut hannefesh, shehen eser bechinoteha hannizkarot leel: chachma-bina-daat kulei, shemmehen nimshechu otiyyot machashava zo hamelubbashot bedibbur ze keshemmedabber, ki hammachashava hi gam ken bechinat otiyyot kemo haddibbur, rak shehen ruchaniyyot vedakkot yoter.
Aval eser bechinot chachma-bina-daat kulei, hen shoresh umekor hammachashava, veen bahem bechinat otiyyot adayin kodem shemmitlabbeshot bilvush hammachashava.

Lemashal, keshennofelet ezo ahava vechemda belibbo shel adam, kodem sheola mehallev el hammoach lechashshev uleharher bah – en bah bechinat otiyyot adayin, rak chefetz pashut vachashika ballev el haddavar hahu hannechmad etzlo.

Vechol shekken kodem shenafla hattaava vehachemda belibbo leoto davar, rak hayta bechoach chachmato vesichlo vidiato, shehaya noda etzlo oto davar shehu nechmad venaim vetov veyafe lehassigo veliddavek bo, kegon: lilmod ezo chachma, o leechol eze maachol arev, rak leachar shekkevar nafla hachemda vehattaava belibbo bechoach chachmato vesichlo vidiato, veachar kach chazra vealta mehallev lammoach – lechashshev uleharher bah ech lehotzi taavato mikkoach el happoal lehassig hammaachol, o lemidat hachachma befoal, hare bechan noldu bechinot otiyyot bemocho, shehen otiyyot kilshon am vaam hamedabberim vehameharharim bahem kol inyeyne haolam:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 21: Vehinne, middat hakkadosh-baruch-hu shello kemiddat basar vadam; shehaadam, keshemmedabber dibbur, hare hevel haddibbur shebbefiv hu muregash venire davar bifne atzmo muvedal mishsharsho, shehen eser bechinot hannefesh atzmah.

Aval hakkadosh-baruch-hu en dibburo muvedal mimmennu yitbarech chas veshalom, ki en davar chutz mimmennu, velet atar panuy minneh, velachen, en dibburo yitbarech kedibburenu chas veshalom [kemo sheen machashavto kemachashavtenu, kedichtiv: "ki lo machshevotay machshevotechem", uchetiv: "ken gavhu derachay middarchechem vegomer"].

Velo nikra dibburo yitbarech beshem "dibbur", rak al derech mashal; kemo sheddibbur hattachton shebbaadam hu megalle lashshomim ma shehaya tzafun venelam bemachashavto, kach lemala – been-sof baruch-hu, yetziat haor vehachayyut mimmennu yitbarech – mehahelem el haggilluy livro olamot ulehachayotam, nikret beshem "dibbur".
Vehen hen asara maamarot shebbahen nivra haolam, vechen shear kol hattora neviim uchetuvim shehissigu hanneviim bemare nevuatam.

Vahare dibburo umachashavto kivyachol meyuchadot immo betachlit hayyichud; derech mashal, kemo dibburo umachashavto shel adam beodan bechoach chachmato vesichlo, o bitshuka vechemda shebbelibbo kodem shealta mehallev lammoach lehareher bah bivchinat otiyyot, sheaz, hayu otiyyot hammachashava vehaddibbur hazze, hannimshachot mechemda uteshuka zo – bechoach ballev umeyuchadot sham betachlit hayyichud besharshan, shehen hachachma vesechel shebbammoach vechemda uteshuka shebballev.

Vechacha mammash, derech mashal, meyuchadot dibburo umachashavto shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu betachlit hayyichud bemahuto veatzmuto yitbarech, gam achar sheyyatza dibburo yitbarech el happoal bivriot haolamot, kemo shehaya meyuchad immo kodem beriat haolamot, veen shum shinnuy kelal lefanav yitbarech, ella el habberuim hamekabbelim chayyutam mibbechinat dibburo yitbarech, bivchinat yetziato kevar el happoal bivriat haolamot, shemmitlabbesh bahem lehachayotam al yede hishtalshelut meilla lealul viridat hammadregot betzimtzumim rabbim veshonim, ad sheyyuchelu habberuim lekabbel chayyutam vehithauutam mimmennu velo yitbattelu bimtziut.

Vechol hatztzimtzumim hem bechinat "hester panim", lehasetir ulehaalim haor vehachayyut hannimshach middibburo yitbarech, shello yitgalle bivchinat gilluy rav shello yuchelu hattachtonim lekabbel, velachen gam ken nidme lahem or vechayyut haddibbur shel makom baruch-hu hamelubbash bahem, keillu hu davar muvedal mimmahuto veatzmuto yitbarech, rak shennimshach mimmennu yitbarech – kemo dibbur shel adam minnafsho.

Ach legabbe hakkadosh-baruch-hu, en shum tzimtzum vehester vehelem mastir umaalim lefanav, vechachashecha kaora", kedichtiv: "gam choshech lo yachshich mimmekka vegomer", mishshum sheen hatztzimtzumim vehallevushim davar nifrad mimmennu yitbarech chas veshalom, ella kehaden kamtza dilvusheh minneh uveh, kemo shekkatuv: "ki Adonai hu haelohim", uchemo shennitbaer bemakom acher.
Velachen kammeh – kulla kela chashiv mammash:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 22: Rak shehattora dibbera kilshon bene adam, venikra battora dibburo shel makom baruch-hu beshem "dibbur" mammash, kedibburo shel adam, lefi shebbeemet kach hu derech yeridat vehameshachat hachayyut lattachtonim, betzimtzumim rabbim vaatzumim, minim mimminim shonim, lehibbarot mehem beruim rabbim, minim mimminim shonim.

Vechol kach gavru veatzmu hatztzimtzumim vehester panim haelyonim, ad sheyyuchelu lehithauot ulehibbarot gam devarim temeim ukelippot vesitra ochora, ulekabbel chayyutam vekiyyumam middevar Adonai veruach piv yitbarech behester panim viridat hammadregot.

Velachen nikraim "elohim acherim", mippene sheyyenikatam vechayyutam enah mibbechinat "panim" ella mibbechinat "achorayim" dikdushsha; uferush "achorayim", keadam hannoten davar lesono shello virtzono, shemmashlicho lo kilachar ketefo, ki machazir panav mimmennu missinato oto.
Kach lemala, bechinat "panim" – hu penimit haratzon haelyon vecheftzo haamitti asher chafetz Adonai lehashepia chayyut lechol hakkarov elav missitra dikdushsha.

Aval hassitra ochora vehattumea – hi toavat Adonai asher sane, veeno mashpia lah chayyut mippenimit haratzon vecheftzo haamitti asher chafetz bah chas veshalom, ki im, keman deshade batar katfoy lesono shello virtzono, rak kede lehaanish et harshaim, velitten sachar tov latztzaddikim deachpayayn lesitra ochora; veze nikra bechinat "achorayim" deratzon haelyon baruch-hu.

Vehinne, ratzon haelyon bivchinat "panim", hu mekor hachayyim hamechayye et kol haolamot, ulefi sheeno shore kelal al hassitra ochora, vegam bechinat "achorayim" shel ratzon haelyon eno melubbash betochah mammash, ella makkif aleha milmala, lechach hi mekom hammita vehattumea, Adonai yishmerenu, ki meat mizzeer or vechayyut, sheyyoneket umekabbelet letochah mibbechinat "achorayim" dikdushsha shellemala, hu bivchinat galut mammash betochah, besod galut hashshechina hannizkar leel.

Velachen nikra beshem "elohim acherim", shehi avoda zara mammash uchefira beachduto shel melech malche hammelachim hakkadosh-baruch-hu, ki meachar sheor vechayyut dikdushsha hu bivchinat galut betochah – enah betela kelal legabbe kedushshat hakkadosh-baruch-hu; veadderabba, magbiah atzmah kannesher, lomar: "ani veafsi od", vechammaamar "yeor li vaani asitini".

Velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha, sheggassut haruach shekula kaavoda zara mammash, ki ikkar veshoresh avoda zara, hu ma shennechshav ledavar bifne atzmo, nifrad mikkedushshato shel makom, velo kefira baAdonai legamre, kidita baggemara – dekaru leh "elaha deelahayya", ella, sheggam hem machashivim atzmam leyesh vedavar bifne atzmo, uvaze, mafridim et atzmam mikkedushshato shel makom baruch hu – meachar sheen betelim lo yitbarech, ki, en kedushsha elyona shora ella al ma shebbatel lo yitbarech kannizkar leel, velachen nikraim "ture difruda" bazzohar hakkadosh, vahare zo kefira beachduto haamittit, dechulla kammeh kela chashiv" uvatel beemet lo yitbarech velirtzono, hamechayye et kullam umehavve otam meayin leyesh tamid:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 23: Veim kol hannizkar leel, yuvan vivoar hetev betosefet beur ma sheamru bazzohar deorayyta vekudesha-berich-hu kulla chad", uvattikunim pershu deramach pikkudin innun ramach evarin demalka".

Lefi shehammitzvot hen penimiyyut ratzon haelyon vecheftzo haamitti, hamelubbash bechol haolamot haelyonim vetachtonim lehachayotam, ki kol chayyutam veshifam taluy bemaase hammitzvot shel hattachtonim, kannoda.
Venimtza shemmaase hammitzvot vekiyyuman hu levush happenimi lifnimit ratzon haelyon, shemmimmaase ze nimshach or vechayyut ratzon haelyon lehitlabbesh baolamot.

Velachen nikraim "evre demalka", derech mashal; kemo sheevre guf haadam hem levush lenafsho uvetelim legamre eleha mikkol vachol, ki miyyad sheole birtzono shel adam lifshot yado o raglo, hen nishmaot lirtzono techef umiyyad beli shum tziuuy vaamira lahen, uveli shum shehiyyay kelal, ella kerega mammash kesheala birtzono, kach derech mashal, hachayyut shel maase hammitzvot vekiyyuman, hu batel legamre legabbe ratzon haelyon hamelubbash bo, venaase lo mammash keguf linshama.

Vechen hallevush hachitzon shel nefesh haelohit shebbaadam hamekayyem veose hammitzva, shehu koach uvechinat hammaase shellah, hu mitlabbesh bachayyut shel maase hammitzva, venaase gam ken keguf linshama laratzon haelyon uvatel elav legamre.

Veal ken, gam evre guf haadam hamekayyeymim hammitzva, shekkoach uvechinat hammaase shel nefesh haelohit melubbash bahem bishat maase vekiyyum hammitzva, hem naasu merkava mammash laratzon haelyon, kegon: hayyad hamechalleket tzedaka laaniyyim, o osa mitzva acheret, veraglayim hamehallechot lidvar mitzva, vechen happe velashon shemmedabberim divre tora, vehammoach shemmeharher bedivre tora veyirat shamayim uvigdullat Adonai baruch-hu.

Vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "haavot hen hen hammerkava", shekkol evrehem kullam hayu kedoshim umuvedalim meinyeyne olam hazze, velo naasu merkava, rak laratzon haelyon levaddo kol yemehem:

Ach hammachashava vehahirhur bedivre tora shebbammoach, vechoach haddibbur bedivre tora shebbappe, shehem levushim happenimim shel nefesh haelohit, vechol shekken nefesh haelohit atzmah hamelubbeshet bahem, kullam meyuchadim mammash beyichud gamur baratzon haelyon, velo merkava levad, ki ratzon haelyon hu hu haddevar halacha atzmah shemmeharher umedabber bah, shekkol hahalachot hen perate hameshachot penimiyyut ratzon haelyon atzmo, shekkach ala birtzono yitbarech, sheddavar ze muttar o kasher o patur o zakkay o lehefech; vechen kol tzerufe otiyyot tora-neviim-ketuvim hen hameshachat retzono vechachmato hameyuchadot been-sof baruch-hu betachlit hayyichud, shehu hayyodea vehu hammadda kulei.
Vezehu shekkatuv deorayyta vekudesha berich hu – kulla chad", velo "evarin demalka" lechud kefikkudin.

Umeachar sheratzon haelyon hameyuchad been-sof baruch-hu betachlit hayyichud, hu begilluy legamre, velo behester panim kelal uchelal, bannefesh haelohit ulevusheha happenimim, shehem machashavtah vedibburah, beotah shaa shehaadam osek bedivre tora, hare gam hannefesh ulevusheha ellu – meyuchadim mammash been-sof baruch-hu beotah shaa betachlit hayyichud, keyichud dibburo umachashavto shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu bemahuto veatzmuto kannizkar leel, ki en shum davar nifrad, ki im behester panim kannizkar leel.

Velo od, ella sheyyichudam hu beyeter seet veyeter oz miyyichud or-en-sof baruch-hu beolamot elyonim, meachar sheratzon haelyon hu begilluy mammash bannefesh ulevusheha haoskim battora, shehare hu hu hattora atzmah, vechol haolamot haelyonim mekabbelim chayyutam meor vechayyut hannimshach mehattora, shehi retzono vechachmato yitbarech, kedichtiv: "kullam bechachma asita", veim ken, hachachma – shehi hattora – lemala mikkullam, vehi hi retzono yitbarech hannikra "sovev kol almin", shehi bechinat ma sheeno yachol lehitlabbesh betoch almin, rak mechayye umeir lemala bivchinat makkif, vehi hi hammitlabbeshet bannefesh ulevusheha bivchinat gilluy mammash – kesheoskim bedivre tora, "veaf-al-gav deihu la chaze kulei" [umishshum hache yachol lisbol, mishshum dela chaze, ma sheen ken baelyonim].

Uvaze yuvan lamma gadla meod maalat haesek battora yoter mikkol hammitzvot, vaafilu mittefilla – shehi yichud olamot elyonim [veha demi sheen torato umanuto tzarich lehafesik, hayeynu meachar demafsik umevattel belav hache].

Umizze yuchal hammaskil lehameshich alav yira gedola beasko battora, kesheyyitbonen ech shennafsho ulevusheha shebbemocho uvefiv, hem meyuchadim mammash betachlit hayyichud baratzon haelyon veor-en-sof baruch-hu mammash hammitgalle bahem, ma shekkol haolamot elyonim vetachtonim – kela chashive kammeh ucheayin vaefes mammash, ad sheeno mitlabbesh betocham mammash, ella, sovev kol almin, bivchinat makkif – lehachayotam ikkar chayyutam, rak ezo heara mitlabbeshet betocham, ma sheyyecholim lisbol, shello yitbattelu bimtziut legamre.

Vezehu shekkatuv: "vaytzavvenu Adonai et kol hachukkim haelle leyira et Adonai vegomer" [veal yira gedola zo amru: "im en chachma, en yira", vehattora nikret etzlah "tara ledarta", kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher], ella, delav kol mocha savil da – yira kazo. ach gam man dela savil mocho kelal yira zo, lo minnah velo miktzatah, mippene pechitut erech nafsho besharshah umekorah – bemadregot tachtonot deeser sefirot daasiyya, en yira zo meakkevet bo lemaase, kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 24: Veze leummat ze", hen shasa mitzvot lo taase deorayyta vechol issure derabbanan, meachar shehen neged retzono vechachmato yitbarech vehefkam mammash – hem nifradim miyyichudo veachduto yitbarech betachlit happerud mammash, kemo hassitra ochora vehakkelippa hannikret "avoda zara" velohim acherim", mechamat hester panim shel ratzon haelyon, kannizkar leel.

Vechen 3 levushe hannefesh shemmikkelippat noga shebbeyisrael, shehem machashava dibbur umaase, hamelubbashim beshasa lo taase deorayyta uderabbanan, vechen mahut hannefesh atzmah hamelubbeshet bilvusheha, kullam meyuchadim mammash besitra ochora ukelippa zo, hannikret "avoda zara".

Velo od, ella shebbetelim utefelim eleha, ugeruim ufechutim mimmenna meod, ki hi, enah melubbeshet beguf chumeri, veyodaat et ribbonah, veenah moredet bo lifol peullatah bemishlachat malache raim shellah – shello bishlichuto shel makom baruch-hu chas veshalom, uchemaamar bilam: "lo uchal laavor et pi Adonai vego".

Veaf shennikra "avoda zara", ha karu leh "elaha deelahayya", veenam yecholim laavor kelal al retzono yitbarech, ki yodim umassigim shehu chayyutam vekiyyumam, sheyyonkim mibbechinat "achorayim daachorayim" shel ratzon haelyon baruch-hu hammakkif alehem, ella sheyyenikatam vechayyutam shebbetocham, hi bivchinat galut betocham – lehachashiv atzman elohut, vahare zo kefira beachduto.

Aval mikkol makom, enan kofrim vechichashu baAdonai legamre velomar lo hu, ella dekaru leh "elaha deelahayya", dehayynu – chayyutam vekiyyumam hannimshach veyored alehem mertzono yitbarech, velachen enan ovrin retzono yitbarech leolam.

Veim ken, haadam haover al retzono yitbarech, hu garua ufachut harebe meod mehassitra ochora ukelippa, hannikret "avoda zara" velohim acherim", vehu betachlit happerud miyyichudo veachduto shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu yoter mimmenna, ucheillu kofer beachduto yoter mimmenna chas veshalom.

Uchemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim shaar 42 sof perek 4, shehara shebbaolam hazze hachumeri, hu shimre hakkelippot haggassot kulei, vehu tachlit habberur vechulei, velachen kol maase olam hazze kashim veraim, veharshaim govrim bo vechulei:

Velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al pasuk: "ki tiste ishto" – "en adam over avera vechulei", daafilu ishsha hamenaefet sheddatah kalla, hayta moshelet beruach taavatah, lule ruach shetut shebbah – hamechasse umastir umaalim et haahava mesutteret shebbenafshah haelohit, ledavka beemunat Adonai veyichudo veachduto, velo lippared chas veshalom meachduto, afilu notlim et nafshah mimmenna laavod avoda zara chas veshalom, vaafilu behishtachavaa levaddah beli shum emuna ballev kelal, vechol shekken lichbosh hayyetzer vetaavat hanniuf, shehem yissurim kallim mimmita, Adonai yishmerenu.

Vehahefresh sheetzlah ben issur niuf leissur hishtachavaa laavoda zara, hu gam ken ruach shetut diklippa hammalbeshet lannefesh haelohit ad bechinat chachma shebbah, velo ad bichlal, mippene or Adonai hamelubbash bachachma, kannizkar leel.

Aval beemet laamitto, afilu avera kalla, hare haovrah over al ratzon haelyon baruch-hu, vehu betachlit happerud miyyichudo veachduto yitbarech, yoter missitra ochora ukelippa hannikret "elohim acherim" vaavoda zara" mammash, veyoter mikkol haddevarim hannishpaim mimmenna baolam hazze, shehem behemot temeot vechayyot veofot temeim ushekatzim uremasim, vechammaamar: "yattush kedamach", perush, deaf yattush – shemmachnis veeno motzi, shehi kelippa hayyoter tachtona, urechoka mibbechinat hakkedushsha hammashpaat betachlit harichuk – kodemet laish hachote, behishtalshelut viridat hachayyut meratzon haelyon baruch-hu, vechol shekken shear baale chayyim hattemeim, vaafilu chayyot raot, shekkullam – enam meshannim tafkidam, ufekuddato yitbarech shamra rucham, veaf-al-gav deihu la chaze kulei", uchemo shekkatuv: "umoraachem vechittechem yihye al kol chayyat haaretz", ucheferush rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha, sheen chayya raa moshelet beadam ella im ken nidme lah kivhema"; vehatztzaddikim, sheen tzelem elohim mistallek meal penehem – kol chayyot raot itkafyayn kammayyhu, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar gabbe daniyyel begov arayot.

Veim ken, hachote veover retzono yitbarech afilu baavera kalla, bishat maase – hu betachlit harichuk mikkedushsha haelyona, shehi yichudo veachduto yitbarech, yoter mikkol baale chayyim hattemeim ushekatzim uremasim hammushepaim missitra ochora ukelippat avoda zara.

Uma sheppikkuach nefesh doche shear averot, vegam "yaavor veal yehareg" hayeynu, keferush chachamenu-zichronam-livracha: "amra tora, challel alav shabbat achat, kede sheyyishmor shabbatot harebe", velo mishshum kallut haaverot vechumeran.

[Teda: – shehare shabbat chamura ushekula kaavoda zara leinyan shechitat mumar ledavar echad – beyore dea siman 2, ma sheen ken bemumar legilluy arayot. vaafilu hache, pikkuach nefesh doche shabbat velo gilluy arayot; ella digzerat hakkatuv hu].

Ella shelleachar maase hachet, im hi meaverot sheen bahen karet umita bide shamayim, sheen nafsho haelohit meta legamre venichretet mishsharshah belohim chayyim, rak shennifgam ketzat devekutah vaachizatah besharshah bechet ze,

Haggaha
ulefi ﬠrech vechilluke bechinot happegam bannefesh uvesharshah baﬠleyonim, kach hem chilluke bechinot hammeruk vehaonesh begehinnom o baolam hazze, lechol ﬠvon vachet onesh meyuchad, lemarek uleahﬠvir hallichluch vehappegam. vechen bechayyayve mita vecharet, en pogmin kullam beshave:

Hare gam nafsho hachiyyunit habbahamit hamelubbeshet begufo, vechen gufo, chozrim veolim mehassitra ochora ukelippa zo, umitkarvim likdushshat nefesh haelohit hamelubbeshet bahem, hammaamina baAdonai echad. vegam bishat hachet hayta veamna itto yitbarech, rak shehayta bivchinat galut mammash toch nefesh habbahamit missitra ochora, hammachatia et hagguf umoridato immah beimke sheol, lematta matta, tachat tumeat hassitra ochora ukelippat avoda zara, Adonai yishmerenu.
Veen lecha galut gadol mizze – "meigra rama kulei", uchemo shennitbaer leel, deshoresh umekor nafshot kol bet yisrael – hu mechachma illaa, vehu yitbarech vechachmato echad vechulei.

Vehu, kimshal haochez berosho shel melech, umorido lematta vetomen panav betoch bet hakkisse male tzoa, sheen lecha elbon gadol mizze, afilu ose ken lefi shaa; shehakkelippot vesitra ochora nikraot "ki tzoa", kannoda:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 25: Vezehu shekkatuv: "ki karov elecha haddavar meod vegomer", shebbechol et uvechol shaa, beyado shel adam uvirshuto hu – lehaavir ruach shetut vehashshichcha mikkirbo, velizkor uleorer ahavato laAdonai echad, hamesutteret bevadday bilvavo beli shum safek.

Vezehu shekkatuv: "uvilvavcha". venichlal bah gam dechilu, dehayynu, shello lippared beshum ofen miyyichudo veachduto yitbarech, afilu bimsirat nefesh mammash, beli shum taam vesechel mussag, ella beteva elohi.

Vechol shekken bishvirat hattaavot, hakkalla miyyissure mita, shekkarov elav haddavar yoter lichbosh hayyetzer, hen bivchinat "sur mera", afilu meavera kalla shel divre sofrim, shello laavor al retzono yitbarech, meachar shennifrad bah miyyichudo veachduto, kemo baavoda zara mammash, bishat maase. vahare gam baavoda zara yachol laasot teshuva achar kach.

[Veaf shehaomer echeta veashuv – en maspikin kulei", hayeynu, sheen machazikim yado lihyot lo sheat hakkosher laasot teshuva, aval im dachak hashshaa veasa teshuva – en lecha davar sheomed bifne hatteshuva.]

Veaf-al-pi-chen, kol ish yisrael muchan umezumman limsor nafsho al kedushshat Adonai, shello lehishtachavot laavoda zara afilu lefi shaa velaasot teshuva achar kach, vehayeynu, mippene or Adonai hamelubbash benafsham kannizkar leel, sheeno bivchinat zeman veshaa kelal, ella lemala mehazzeman, veshallit umoshel alav, kannoda.

Vehen bivchinat "vaase tov", lehitgabber kaari bigvura veometz hallev, neged hayyetzer hammachbid et gufo umappil alav atzla, mibbechinat yesod heafar shebbannefesh habbahamit, millehatriach gufo bizrizut bechol mine torach vaavodat massa baavodat Adonai sheyyesh bah torach veamal, kegon: laamol battora beiyyun uvappe – la fasik pumeh miggirsa, uchemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "leolam yasim adam atzmo al divre tora keshor leol vechachamor lemasoy", vechen litfilla bechavvana – bechol kocho mammash, vechen baavodat Adonai shehi bedavar shebbemamon, kemo avodat hatztzedaka;

Vechayyotze veellu mimmilchamot hayyetzer vetachbulotav, lekarer nefesh haadam shello lehafekir mamono uveriut gufo, shellaamod negdo ulechavsho, karov meod el haadam, kesheyyasim el libbo, shellenatztzeach hayyetzer bechol ze, veyoter mizze, velaasot hefko mammash – kal meod miyyissure mita, Adonai yishmerenu, veyissure mita, Adonai yishmerenu, haya mekabbel beahava uveratzon – shello lippared miyyichudo veachduto yitbarech afilu lefi shaa, lehishtachavot laavoda zara chas veshalom.

Vechol shekken sheyyesh lo lekabbel beahava uveratzon – kede ledavka vo leolam vaed. dehayynu, kesheyyaase retzono yitbarech baavoda zo, yitgalle bah penimit ratzon haelyon bivchinat panim vegilluy rav velo vehester kelal. uchesheen shum hester panim baratzon haelyon, azay – en davar nifrad kelal uchelal lihyot yesh vedavar bifne atzmo.
Velazot, tihyena nafsho haelohit vehachiyyunit ulevushehen kullan, meyuchadot betachlit hayyichud baratzon haelyon veor en-sof baruch-hu, kannizkar leel.

Veyichud ze lemala – hu nitzchi leolam vaed, ki hu yitbarech uretzono lemala mehazzeman. vechen, gilluy retzono shebbedibburo, shehi hattora, hu nitzchi, uchemo shekkatuv: "udevar elohenu yakum leolam", "udevarav chayim vekayyaymim kulei", "velo yachalif velo yamir dato leolamim kulei".

Ella shellematta, hu tachat hazzeman uveotah shaa levaddah sheosek bah battora o bemitzva, ki achar kach, im osek bedavar acher – nifrad mehayyichud haelyon lematta, [vehayeynu, kesheosek bidvarim betelim legamre, sheen bahem tzorech kelal laavodat Adonai.]

Veaf-al-pi-chen, keshechozer veshav laavodat Adonai achar kach, letora velitfilla, umevakkesh mechila meAdonai al shehaya efshar lo laasok az battora velo asak, Adonai yislach lo, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "avar al mitzvat ase veshav lo zaz mishsham ad shemmochalin lo".
Velaze, tikkenu birkat "selach lanu" shalosh peamim bechol yom – al avon bittul tora, sheen adam nitztzol mimmennu bechol yom; uchemo hattamid – shehaya mechapper al mitzvot ase.
Veen ze "echeta veashuv", ella im ken, shebbishat hachet mammash, hu somech al hatteshuva ulechach chote, kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher:

Uvaze yuvan, lamma tzivva moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom, bemishne tora, laddor shennichnesu laaretz, likrot keriat shema paamayim bechol yom, lekabbel alav malchut shamayim bimsirat nefesh, vahalo hivtiach lahem: "pachdechem umoraachem yitten Adonai vegomer"; ella, mishshum shekkiyyum hattora umitzvoteha, taluy baze sheyyizkor tamid inyan mesirat nafsho laAdonai al yichudo, sheyyihye kavua belibbo tamid mammash, yomam valayla lo yamish mizzichrono, ki, baze yuchal laamod neged yitzro lenatztzecho tamid bechol et uvechol shaa, – kannizkar leel:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 26: Beram, kegon da tzarich leodoe kelal gadol: ki kemo shennitztzachon lenatztzeach davar gashmi, kegon: shene anashim hammitabbekim ze im ze lehappil ze et ze, hinne, im haechad hu beatzlut uchevedut – yenutztzach bekal veyippol gam im hu gibbor yoter mechavero, kacha mammash benitzchon hayyetzer, i efshar lenatztzecho beatzlut uchevedut – hannimshachot meatzvut vetimtum hallev kaeven, ki im, bizrizut – hannimshechet missimcha ufetichat hallev, vetohorato mikkol nidnud deaga vaetzev baolam.

Uma shekkatuv: "bechol etzev yihye motar", perush, sheyyihye eze yitron umaala mizze, hinne adderabba, millashon ze mashma, shehaetzev mitztzad atzmo en bo maala, rak, sheyyaggia veyavo mimmennu eze yitron, vehayeynu – hassimcha haamittit baAdonai elohav, habbaa achar haetzev haamitti leittim mezummanim al avonotav bemar nafsho velev nishbar, sheal yede ze, nishbera ruach hattumea vesitra ochora umechitza shel barzel hammafseket beno leaviv shebbashshamayim, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar al pasuk: "ruach nishbara, lev nishbar vegomer", vaazay yekuyyam bo resheh dikra: "tashmieni sason vesimcha vegomer, hashiva li seson yishecha, veruach nediva vegomer".

Vezehu taam happashut letikkun haari zichrono livracha, lomar mizmor ze achar tikkun chatzot kodem hallimmud – kede lilmod besimcha amittit baAdonai habbaa achar haetzev; sheyyesh lesimcha zo yitron, keyitron haor habba min hachoshech davka, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar al pasuk: "veraiti sheyyesh yitron lachachma min hassichlut kitron haor kulei", ayyen sham, veday lammevin.
Umikra male dibber hakkatuv: "tachat asher lo avadta et Adonai elohecha besimcha vegomer", venoda lakkol perush haari zichrono livracha al pasuk ze:

Vehinne, etza hayyeutza letaher libbo mikkol etzev venidnud deaga mimmille dealma, vaafilu bane chayye umezone, mudaat zot lakkol maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "keshem shemmevarech al hattova kulei", ufershu baggemara: "lekabbule besimcha", kemo simchat hattova hanniglet veniret, ki "gam zo – letova", rak sheenah niglet veniret leene vasar, ki, hi mealma deitkasya" shellemala mealma deitgalyay", shehu – 11 mishshem havaya baruch-hu, vealma deitkasya" – hu 15, vezehu shekkatuv: "ashre haggever asher teyasserennu yah vegomer".

Velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha, ki "hassemechim beyissurim – alehem hakkatuv omer: veohavav ketzet hashshemesh bigvurato", ki, hassimcha hi meahavato kirvat Adonai yoter mikkol chayye haolam hazze, kedichtiv: "ki tov chasdecha mechayyim vegomer", vekirvat Adonai – hi beyeter seet umaala leen ketz bealma deitkasya", ki "sham chevyon uzzo" veyoshev beseter elyon", veal ken zoche letzet hashshemesh bigvurato" leatid lavo, shehi yetziat chamma minarteka, shehi mechussa bo baolam hazze, veleatid – titgalle mikkissuyah, dehayynu, sheaz yitgalle alma deitkasya, veyizrach veyair begilluy rav veatzum lechol hachosim bo baolam hazze umistoffim betzillo, tzel hachachma, shehu bechinat tzel velo ora vetova niret, veday lammevin:

Ach haatzvut mimmille dishmayya tzarich lashit etzot benafsho lippater mimmenna, en tzarich lomar bishat avoda, shetztzarich laavod Adonai besimcha uvetuv levav, ella afilu mi shehu baal asakim vederech eretz, im nofel lo etzev udeaga mimmille dishmayya bishat asakav, beyadua shehu tachbulat hayyetzer – kede lehappilo achar kach betaavot chas veshalom, kannoda, sheim lo chen, meayin baa lo atzvut amittit mechamat ahavat Adonai o yirato, beemtza asakav.

Vehinne, ben shennafla lo haatzvut bishat avoda betalmud tora o bitfilla, uven shennafla lo shello bishat avoda, zot yasim el libbo: ki en hazzeman gerama kaet leatzvut amittit, afilu ledaagat avonot chamurim chas veshalom, rak lazot tzarich keviut ittim usheat hakkosher beyishshuv haddaat, lehitbonen bigdullat Adonai asher chata lo, kede sheal yede ze yihye libbo nishbar beemet bimrirut amittit.

Vechimvoar et zo bemakom acher. vesham nitbaer gam ken, ki miyyad achar shennishbar libbo beittim kevuim hahem, azay yasir haetzev millibbo legamre, veyaamin emuna shelema ki Adonai heevir chattato "verav lisloach". vezo hi hassimcha haamittit baAdonai habbaa achar haetzev, kannizkar leel:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 27: Veim haatzvut enah middaagat avonot, ella mehirhurim raim vetaavot raot shennoflot bemachashavto. hinne im noflot lo shello bishat haavoda, ella beet asko baasakav vederech eretz uchehay gavvna, adderabba! yesh lo lismoach bechelko, sheaf shennoflot lo bemachashavto – hu massiach dato mehen, lekayyem ma shenneemar: "velo taturu achare levavchem veachare enechem asher attem zonim acharehem".

Veen hakkatuv medabber betzaddikim lekaram "zonim" chas veshalom, ella bevenonim kayyotze vo, shennoflim lo hirhure niuf bemachashavto, ben behetter kulei, ucheshemmassiach dato – mekayyem lav ze, veamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "yashav velo avar avera – notnim lo sachar keillu asa mitzva", veal ken tzarich lismoach bekiyyum hallav, kemo bekiyyum mitzvat ase mammash.

Veadderabba, haatzvut hi miggassut haruach, sheeno makkir mekomo, veal ken yera levavo al sheeno bemadregat tzaddik, shelletzaddikim bevadday en noflim lahem hirhure shetut kaellu, ki illu haya makkir mekomo, shehu rachok meod mimmadregat tzaddik, vehalevay haya benoni velo rasha kol yamav, afilu shaa achat, hare zot hi middat habbenonim vaavodatam – lichbosh hayyetzer vehahirhur haole mehallev lammoach, ulehassiach dato legamre mimmennu, velidchoto bishte yadayim, kannizkar leel.

Uvechol dechiyya udechiyya shemmadchehu mimmachashavto, itkafya sitra ochora letatta, uveitaruta diltatta – itaruta dilella, veitkafya sitra ochora dilella hammagbiah atzmah kannesher, lekayyem ma shenneemar: "im tagbiah kannesher vegomer mishsham oridcha, neum Adonai".

Uchemo shehiflig bazzohar parashat teruma [daf 128], begodel nachat ruach lefanav yitbarech kad itkafya sitra ochora letatta, deistallek yekara dekudesha-berich-hu leella al kulla, yatir mishshevacha ochora, veistallekuta da yattir mikkulla vechulei.
Velachen, al yippol lev adam alav, velo yera levavo meod, gam im yihye ken kol yamav bemilchama zo, ki ulay lechach nivra, vezot avodato leachpaya lesitra ochora tamid.

Veal ze amar iyyov: "barata reshaim"; velo sheyyihyu reshaim beemet chas veshalom, ella sheyyaggia alehem kemaase harshaim bemachashavtam vehirhuram levad, vehem yihyu nilchamim tamid lehassiach datam mehem, kede leachpaya lesitra ochora, velo yuchelu levattelah mikkol vachol, ki ze naase al yede tzaddikim.

Ushene mine nachat ruach lefanav yitbarech lemala: echad – mibbittul hassitra ochora legamre, veithappecha mimmeriru lemitka umechashocha linhora, al yede hatztzaddikim. vehashshenit – kad itkafya hassitra ochora beodah betakpah ugevuratah umagbiah atzmah kannesher, umishsham moridah Adonai beitaruta diltatta al yede habbenonim.

Vezehu sheamar hakkatuv: "vaase li matammim kaasher ahavti" – "matammim" leshon rabbim; shene mine nachat ruach, vehu maamar hashshechina levaneha – kelalut yisrael kidfershu battikkunim, uchemo shebbematammim gashmiyyim, derech mashal, yesh shene mine maadannim: echad, mimmaachalim arevim umetukim, vehashsheni, middevarim charifim o chamutzim, rak shehem metubbalim umetukkanim hetev ad shennaasu maadannim lehashiv hannefesh.

Vezehu sheamar hakkatuv: "kol paal Adonai lammaanehu, vegam rasha leyom raa"; perush, sheyyashuv merisho veyaase hara shello yom veor lemala, kad itkafya sitra ochora veistallek yekara dekudesha-berich-hu leela.

Velo od, ella afilu bidvarim hammuttarim legamre, kol ma shehaadam zoveach yitzro afilu shaa kalla, umitkaven leachpaya lesitra ochora shebbechalal hassemali, kegon shechafetz leechol, umeacher seuddato ad leachar shaa o pachot, veosek battora beotah shaa, kidita baggemara: "shaa reviit maachal kol adam, shaa shishshit maachal talmide chachamim", vehayu marivim atzmam shete shaot lechavvavna zo, af sheggam achar hasseudda hayu lomdim kol hayyom.

Vechen im bolem piv milledabber devarim shellibbo mitavve meod ledabberam meinyeyne haolam, vechen behirhure machashavto, afilu bimat mizzeer, deitkafya sitra ochora letatta – istallek yekara dekudesha-berich-hu ukedushshato leella harebe. umikkedushsha zo nimshechet kedushsha elyona al haadam lematta, lesayyeyo siyyua rav veatzum laavodato yitbarech.

Vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "adam mekaddesh atzmo meat lematta – mekaddeshin oto harebe milmala". levad ma shemmekayyem mitzvat ase shel tora: "vehitkaddishtem vechulei", keshemmekaddesh atzmo bammuttar lo.

Uferush "vehitkaddishtem" – shettaasu atzmechem kedoshim; kelomar, af shebbeemet eno kadosh umuvedal missitra ochora, ki hi betakpah uvigvuratah ketoladtah bechalal hassemali, rak shekkovesh yitzro umekaddesh atzmo, "vihyitem kedoshim" – kelomar, sofo lihyot kadosh umuvedal beemet mehassitra ochora, al yede shemmekaddeshim oto harebe milmala, umesayyeyim oto legarshah millibbo meat meat:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 28: Vaafilu im noflim lo hirhure taavot ushear machashavot zarot bishat haavoda battora o bitfilla bechavvavna, al yashit lev alehen, ella yassiach dato mehen kerega.

Vegam, al yehi shote laasok behaalaat hammiddot shel hammachashava zara, kannoda, ki lo neemru devarim hahem ella letzaddikim, sheen noflim lahem machashavot zarot shellahem ki im mishshel acherim. aval mi shennofel lo mishshello, mibbechinat hara shebbelibbo bechalal hassemali, ech yaalehu lemala, vehu atzmo mekushshar lematta?

Ach af-al-pi-chen, al yippol libbo bekirbo lihyot mizze atzev nivze bishat haavoda, shetztzarich lihyot besimcha rabba, ella adderabba, yitchazzek yoter veyosif ometz bechol kocho bechavvavnat hattefilla bechedva vesimcha yetera, besumo el libbo, ki nefilat hammachashava zara hi mehakkelippa shebbechalal hassemali, haosa milchama bevenoni im nefesh elohit shebbo.

Venoda derech hannilchamim vechen hanneevakim yachad, kesheechad mitgabber, azay hashsheni mitammetz lehitgabber gam ken bechol maamatztze kocho. velachen, keshennefesh haelohit mitammetzet umitgabberet lehitpallel, azay gam hakkelippa mitgabberet kenegdah, levalbelah ulehappilah bemachashava zara shellah.

Velo ketaut haolam, shettoim lehochiach minnefilat hammachashava zara – mikkelal sheen tefillatam kelum, sheillu hitpallel karauy venachon – lo hayu noflim lo machashavot zarot. vehaemet haya kedivrehem, im hayta nefesh achat levaddah, hi hammitpallelet vehi hamechashshevet umeharheret hammachashavot zarot.

Aval beemet laamitto, hen shete nefashot, hannilchamot zo im zo bemocho shel adam, kol achat cheftzah uretzonah limshol bo velihyot hammoach memulla mimmenna levaddah, vechol hirhure tora veyirat shamayim – minnefesh haelohit, vechol mille dealma – minnefesh habbahamit, rak shehaelohit melubbeshet bah.

Vehu kimshal adam hammitpallel bechavvavna, veomed lenegdo arel rasha, umesiach umedabber immo kede levalbelo, shezzot atzato bevadday, shello lehashiv lo mittov vead ra, velaasot atzmo kecheresh lo yishma, ulekayyem ma shekkatuv: "al taan kesil beivvalto, pen tishve lo gam atta".

Kach, al yashiv meuma veshum taana umaane neged hammachashava zara, ki hammitabbek im menuvvavl – mitnavvevl gam ken; rak yaase atzmo kelo yodea velo shomea hahirhurim shennaflu lo, visirem middato, veyosif ometz bechoach kavvavnato.

Veim yikshe lo lahasiram middato, mippene shettordim dato meod bechazka – azay, yashpil nafsho laAdonai veyitchannen lo yitbarech bemachashavto, lerachem alav berachamav hamerubbim, kerachem av al banim hannimshachim mimmocho, vechacha yerachem Adonai al nafsho hannimshechet meitto yitbarech, lehatztzilah mimmayim hazzedonim", ulemaano yaase, "ki chelek Adonai" – mammash – "ammo":
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 29: Ach od achat tzarich lashit etzot benafshot habbenonim, asher lifamim veittim rabbim yesh lahem timtum hallev shennaase kaeven, velo yachol liftoach libbo beshum ofen laavoda shebballev zo tefilla.
Vegam, lifamim lo yuchal lehillachem im hayyetzer, lekaddesh atzmo bemuttar lo, mippene kevedut shebbelibbo.
Vezot hi etza hayyeutza bazzohar hakkadosh, deamar rav metivta began eden: "aa dela salik beh nehora – mevatteshin leh kulei. gufa dela salik beh nehora denishmeta – mevatteshin leh kulei".
Perush "nehora denishmeta", sheor hanneshama vehassechel eno meir kol kach limshol al chumeriut shebbagguf.

Veaf shemmevin umitbonen besichlo bigdullat Adonai, eno nitpas venidbak bemocho kol kach sheyyuchal limshol al chumeriyyut hallev, mechamat chumeriyyutan vegassutan. vehassibba – hi gassut hakkelippa, shemmagbiah atzmah al or kedushshat nefesh haelohit, umasteret umachashicha orah.

Velazot, tzarich levatteshah ulehashpilah leafar, dehayynu, likboa ittim lehashepil atzmo, lihyot "nivze veenav nimas", kakkatuv, velev nishbar" – "ruach nishbara", hi hassitra ochora, shehi hi haadam atzmo babbenonim, shennefesh hachiyyunit hamechayya hagguf, hi betakpah ketoladtah belibbo, nimtza – hi hi haadam atzmo.

Veal nefesh haelohit shebbo neemar: "neshama shennatatta bi tehora hi", "shennatatta bi" dayyka, mikkelal, shehaadam atzmo enennu hanneshama hattehora, ki im batztzaddikim, shebbahem hu lehefech, shenneshama hattehora shehi nefesh haelohit – hu haadam, vegufam nikra – "besar adam".

Uchemaamar hillel hazzaken letalmidav keshehaya holech leechol, haya omer, shehu holech ligmol chesed im haaluva vaaniyya – hu gufo, ki kemo zar nechshav etzlo, velachen amar, shehu gomel chesed immo bema shemmaachilo, ki hu atzmo eno rak nefesh haelohit levad, ki hi levaddah mechayya gufo uvesaro, shehara shehaya bannefesh hachiyyunit hamelubbeshet bedamo uvesaro – nithappech letov, venichlal bikdushshat nefesh haelohit mammash, batztzaddikim.
Aval babbenoni, meachar shemmahutah veatzmutah shel nefesh hachiyyunit habbahamit shemmissitra ochora, hamelubbeshet bedamo uvesaro, lo nehpach letov – hare hi hi haadam atzmo.

Veim ken hu rachok meAdonai betachlit harichuk, shehare koach hammitavve shebbenafsho habbahamit, yachol gam ken lehitauot lidvarim haasurim shehem neged retzono yitbarech, af sheeno mitavve laasotam befoal mammash chas veshalom, rak sheenam meusim etzlo beemet, kevatztzaddikim, kemo shennitbaer leel [perek 12]. uvaze hu garua umeshukkatz umetoav yoter mibbaale chayyim hattemeim ushekatzim uremasim kannizkar leel, uchemo shekkatuv: "veanochi tolaat velo ish vegomer".
[Vegam keshemmitgabberet bo nafsho haelohit leorer haahava laAdonai bishat hattefilla – enah beemet laamitto legamre, meachar shecholefet veoveret achar hattefilla, kannizkar leel sof perek 13.]
Uvifrat kesheyyizkor tumeat nafsho bechattat neurim, vehappegam sheasa baelyonim, vesham hu lemala mehazzeman, ucheillu pagam venitma hayyom – chas veshalom – mammash.
Veaf shekkevar asa teshuva nechona, hare ikkar hatteshuva – ballev, vehallev, yesh bo bechinot umadregot rabbot, vehakkol lefi ma shehu adam, ulefi hazzeman vehammakom, kayyadua layyodim.

Velachen, achshav beshaa zo, sheroe beatzmo dela salik beh nehora denishmeta, mikkelal, shehayyom lo nitkabbela teshuvato, vaavonotav mavdilim, o, sherotzim lehaaloto litshuva illaa yoter, meumeka delibba yoter. velachen amar david: "vechattati negdi tamid".

Vegam mi shehu naki mechattovt neurim hachamurim, yasim el libbo lekayyem maamar zohar hakkadosh, lihyot mimmare dechushebana", dehayynu, laasot cheshbon im nafsho, mikkol hammachashavot vehaddibburim vehammaasim shechalfu veavru miyyom heyoto ad hayyom hazze, im hayu kullam mitztzad hakkedushsha, o, mitztzad hattumea rachamana litztzelan, dehayynu, kol hammachashavot vehaddibburim vehammaasim asher lo laAdonai hemma velirtzono velaavodato, shezzehu perush leshon "sitra ochora", kannizkar leel [beferek 6].

Umudaat zot, ki kol et shehaadam mechashshev machashavot kedoshot – naase merkava beet zo lehechlot hakkedushsha, shemmehen mushepaot machashavot hallalu. vechen lehefech, naase merkava temea beet zo lehechlot hattumea, shemmehen mushepaot kol machashavot raot, vechen bedibbur umaase.

Od yasim el libbo, rov chalomotav, shehem hevel ureut ruach, mishshum sheen nafsho ola lemala, uchemo shekkatuv: "mi yaale behar Adonai, neki chappayim vegomer", veinun sitrin bishin atyayn umitdabbekan beh umodin leh bechelma millin dealma vechulei, ulezimnin dechayychan beh veachaziu leh mille shekar vetzaarin leh bechelmeh kulei", kemo shekkatuv bazzohar vayyikra [daf 25 ammud 1 veammud 2], ayyen sham baarichut.

Vehinne, kol ma sheyyaarich beinyaynim ellu bemachashavto vegam beiyyuno bisfarim, lihyot libbo nishbar bekirbo, venivze veenav nimas" kakkatuv, betachlit hammius, ulemaes chayyav mammash, hare baze memaes umevazze hassitra ochora umashpilah leafar, umoridah miggedullatah vegassut ruchah vegavhutah, shemmagbiah et atzmah al or kedushshat nefesh haelohit lehachashich orah.

Vegam, yarim aleha bekol raash verogez lehashepilah, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "leolam yargiz adam yetzer tov al yetzer hara, shenneemar: rigzu vegomer", dehayynu, lirgoz al nefesh habbahamit, shehi yitzro hara, bekol raash verogez bemachashavto, lomar lo: "atta ra verasha umeshukkatz umetoav umenuvvavl vechulei – kechol hashshemot shekkaru lo chachamenu-zichronam-livracha – beemet; ad matay tastir lifne or-en-sof baruch-hu, hamemalle kol almin, haya hove veyihye beshave, gam bemakom ze sheani alav, kemo shehaya or en-sof baruch-hu levaddo kodem shennivra haolam, beli shum shinnuy, kemo shekkatuv: "ani Adonai lo shaniti", ki hu lemala mehazzeman vechulei, veatta menuvvavl vechulei, machchish haemet hannire laenayim, dechulla kammeh kela mammash beemet, bivchinat reiyyay chushiyyit".

Vehinne, al yede ze yoil lenafsho haelohit, lehair eneha beemet yichud or-en-sof biriyya chushiyyit, velo bechinat shemia vahavana levaddah, kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher, shezzehu shoresh kol haavoda.

Vehattaam, lefi shebbeemet en shum mammashut kelal basitra ochora, shellachen nimshela lechoshech sheen bo shum mammashut kelal, umimmela nidche mippene haor, vechach hassitra ochora, af sheyyesh bah chayyut harebe, lehachayot kol baale chayyim hattemeim venafshot ummot haolam, vegam nefesh habbahamit shebbeyisrael kannizkar leel, mikkol makom, hare kol chayyutah enah mitztzad atzmah chas veshalom, ella mitztzad hakkedushsha kannizkar leel, velachen hi betela legamre mippene hakkedushsha, kevittul hachoshech mippene haor haggashmi. rak shellegabbe kedushshat nefesh haelohit shebbaadam, natan lah hakkadosh-baruch-hu reshut vicholet lehagebiah atzmah kenegdah, kede shehaadam yitorer lehitgabber aleha, lehashepilah al yede shiflut unemichut rucho, venivze veenav nimas".

Uveitaruta diltatta – itaruta dilella, lekayyem ma shenneemar: "mishsham oridcha , neum Adonai", dehayynu, shemmesirah mimmemshaltah vichaltah, umesallek mimmenna hakkoach ureshut shennittan lah lehagebiah atzmah neged or kedushshat nefesh haelohit, vaazay, mimmela betela venidchet, kevittul hachoshech mippene or haggashmi.

Uchemo shemmatzinu davar ze meforash battora gabbe meraggelim, shemmittechilla amru: "ki chazak hu mimmennu" – "al tikre mimmennu kulei", shello heeminu bicholet Adonai, veachar kach chazru veamru: "hinnennu vealinu vego"; umeayin chazra uvaa lahem haemuna bicholet Adonai? hare lo hera lahem moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom shum ot umofet al ze bentayim, rak sheamar lahem ech shekkatzaf Adonai alehem venishba shello lahaviam el haaretz; uma hoil ze lahem, im lo hayu maaminim bicholet Adonai chas veshalom lichbosh 31 melachim, umippene ze lo ratzu kelal likkanes laaretz?

Ella vadday, mippene sheyyisrael atzman hem "maaminim bene maaminim", rak shehassitra ochora hamelubbeshet begufam higbiah atzmah al or kedushshat nafsham haelohit begassut ruchah vegavhutah, bechutzepa beli taam vadaat, velachen, miyyad shekkatzaf Adonai alehem, vehirim bekol raash verogez: "ad matay laeda haraa hazzot vegomer", "bammidbar hazze yippelu figrechem vego", "ani Adonai dibbarti, im lo zot eese lechol haeda haraa hazzot vegomer", uchesheshshamu devarim kashim ellu, nichna venishbar libbam bekirbam, kedichtiv: "vayyitabbelu haam meod", umimmela, nafla hassitra ochora mimmemshaltah vegavhutah vegassut ruchah, veyisrael atzman hem maaminim.
Umizze yachol lilmod kol adam shennoflim lo bemachashavto sefekot al emuna, ki hem divre ruach hassitra ochora levaddah, hammagbiah atzmah al nafsho, aval yisrael atzman hem "maaminim kulei".

Vegam hassitra ochora atzmah, en lah sefekot kelal beemuna, rak shennittan lah reshut levalbel haadam bedivre sheker umirma, leharebot secharo, kefittuye hazzona leven hammelech besheker umirma birshut hammelech, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 30: Od zot yasim el libbo, lekayyem maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "veheve shefal ruach bifne kl haadam". veheve – beemet laamitto, "bifne chol haadam" – mammash, afilu bifne kal shebbekallim. vehayeynu, al pi maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "al tadin et chaverach – ad shettaggia limkomo".

Ki mekomo gorem lo lachato, lihyot parnasato lelech bashshuk kol hayyom, velihyot miyyoshve keranot, veenav root kol hattaavot, vehaayin roa vehallev chomed", veyitzro boer "ketannur boera meofe", kemo shekkatuv behoshea, "hu voer keesh lehava vegomer".

Ma sheen ken mi sheholech bashshuk meat, verov hayyom yoshev beveto, vegam im holech kol hayyom bashshuk, yachol lihyot sheeno mechummam kol kach betivo, ki en hayyetzer shave bechol nefesh, yesh sheyyitzro kulei, kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher.

Vehinne, beemet, gam mi shehu mechummam meod betivo, ufarnasato hi lihyot miyyoshve keranot kol hayyom, en lo shum hitnatztzelut al chataav, umikre "rasha gamur" al asher en pachad elohim leneged enav.
Ki haya lo lehitappek velimshol al ruach taavavto shebbelibbo, mippene pachad Adonai haroe kol maasav, kemo shennitbaer leel, ki hammoach shallit al hallev betoladto.
Vehinne, beemet, shehi milchama gedola vaatzuma, lishbor hayyetzer habboer keesh lehava mippene pachad Adonai, uchemo nissayon mammash.

Vehilchach, tzarich kol adam, lefi ma shehu mekomo umadregato baavodat Adonai, lishkol velivchon beatzmo im hu oved Adonai beerech uvechinat milchama atzuma kazo venissayon kaze, bivchinat "vaase tov". kegon, baavodat hattefilla bechavvavna, lishpoch nafsho lifne Adonai bechol kocho mammash ad mitztzuy hannefesh, ulehillachem im gufo venefesh habbahamit shebbo hammonim hakkavvavna – bemilchama atzuma, ulevattesham ulechattetam keafar kodem hattefilla shacharit vearvit midde yom beyom, vegam bishat hattefilla, leyaygea atzmo bigiat nefesh vigiat basar, kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman baarichut.

Vechol shello higgia lide midda zo, lehillachem im gufo milchama atzuma kazo – adayin lo higgia livchinat veerech milchemet hayyetzer habboer keesh lehava, lihyot nichna venishbar mippene pachad Adonai.
Vechen beinyan birkat hammazon vechol birchot hannehenin vehammitzvot bechavvana, veen tzarich lomar kavvanat hammitzvot lishman.
Vechen beinyan esek limmud hattora, lilmod harebe yoter mecheftzo uretzono lefi tivo uregiluto al yede milchama atzuma im gufo.

Ki hallomed meat yoter mittivo hare zo milchama ketanna, veen lah erech vedimyon im milchemet hayyetzer habboer keesh, demikre "rasha gamur" im eno menatztzeach yitzro, lihyot nichna venishbar mippene Adonai.
Uma li bechinat "sur mera", uma li bechinat "vaase tov" – hakkol hi mitzvat hammelech hakkadosh, yachid umeyuchad baruch-hu.
Vechen bishar mitzvot, uvifrat bedavar shebbemamon, kemo avodat hatztzedaka uchehay gavna.

Vaafilu bivchinat "sur mera", yachol kol ish maskil limtzo benafsho sheeno sar legamre mehara bakkol mikkol kol, bemakom shetztzarich lemilchama atzuma keerech hannizkar leel, vaafilu pachot meerech hannizkar leel, kegon lehafesik beemtza sicha naa, o sippur bignut chavero, vaafilu genay katan vekal meod, af shehu emet, vaafilu kede lenakkot atzmo, kannoda meha deamar rabbi shimon leaviv rabbenu hakkadosh: "lav ana katveh, ella yehuda chayyayta katveh", veamar lo: "kallech millashon hara" [ayyen sham baggemara resh perek 10 devava batra].

Uchehay gavna kamma mille dishchiche tuva. uvifrat beinyan lekaddesh atzmo bemuttar lo, shehu middeorayyta, kemo shekkatuv: "kedoshim tihyu vegomer", "vehitkaddishtem vegomer". vegam, divre sofrim chamurim middivre tora vechulei.
Ella shekkol ellu vechayyotze vahen, hen meavonot shehaadam dash baakevav", vegam naasu kehetter, mechamat sheavar veshana vechulei.

Aval beemet, im hu yodea sefer, umachazik betorat Adonai, vekirvat elokim yechpatz – gadol avono minneso, veashmato gadla bechifle chiflayim bema sheeno nilcham umitgabber al yitzro beerech uvechinat milchama atzuma hannizkeret leel, meashmat kal shebbekallim miyyoshve keranot harchokim meAdonai vetorato, veen ashmatam gedola kol kach bema sheenam kovshim yitzram habboer keesh lehava, mippene pachad Adonai hammevin umabbit el kol maasehem, keashmat kol hakkarev hakkarev el Adonai veel torato vaavodato, uchemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha gabbe acher: "sheyyada bichvodi vechulei".
Velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al amme haaretz: shezzedonot naasu lahem kishgagot":
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 31: Vehinne, af im kesheyyaarich harebe lehaamik bainyaynim hannizkarim leel keshaa ushetayim, lihyot binmichat ruach velev nishbar, yavo lide atzvut gedola – lo yachush.

Veaf sheatzvut hi mitztzad kelippat noga, velo mitztzad hakkedushsha, ki betzad hakkedushsha ketiv: "oz vechedva bimkomo", veen hashshechina shora ella mittoch simcha" "vechen lidvar halacha vechulei", ella, sheim haatzvut hi mimmille dishmayya, hi mibbechinat tov shebbenoga.

[Velachen katav haari zichrono livracha, sheafilu daagat haavonot enah reuya ki im bishat havvidduy, velo bishat hattefilla vetalmud tora, shetztzarich lihyot besimcha shemmitztzad hakkedushsha davvka]
Af-al-pi-chen, hare kach hi hammidda, leachpaya lesitra ochora beminah vedugematah. kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "minneh uveh ibba lishdya beh narga", ufaga bo kayyotze vo".
Veal ze neemar: "bechol etzev yihye motar", vehayyitron, hi hassimcha habbaa achar haetzev, kedilkamman.

Ach beemet, en lev nishbar umerirut hannefesh – al richukah meor pene Adonai vehitlabbeshutah besitra ochora – nikraim beshem "atzvut" kelal bilshon hakkodesh, ki atzvut – hi shellibbo metumetam kaeven veen chayyut belibbo, aval merirut velev nishbar, adderabba, hare yesh chayyut belibbo lehitpael ulehitmarmer, rak shehi chayyut mibbechinat gevurot kedoshot, vehassimcha mibbechinat chasadim, ki hallev – kalul mishtehen.

Vehinne, leittim tzarich leorer bechinat gevurot hakkedoshot kede lehametik haddinim, shehem bechinat nefesh habbahamit veyetzer hara kesheshsholet chas veshalom al haadam, ki en haddinim nimtakin ella besharshan. velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "leolam yargiz adam yetzer hattov", vehayeynu, bechol et sheroe benafsho shetztzarich lechach.

Ach sheat hakkosher, shehi shaa hameyuchedet ureuya lechach lerov bene adam, hi beshaa shehu atzev belav hache mimmille dealma, o kach beli shum sibba, azay hi sheat hakkosher lehappech haetzev lihyot mimmare dechushebana" hannizkar leel, ulekayyem maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha "leolam yargiz vechulei", kannizkar leel, uvaze yippater mehaatzvut shemmimmille dealma.

Veachar kach yavo lide simcha amittit. dehayynu, shezzot yashiv el libbo lenachamo bechiflayim, achar haddevarim vehaemet haelle hannizkarim leel, lemor lelibbo: "emet hu ken beli safek, sheani rachok meod meAdonai betachlit, umeshukkatz umetoav kulei, ach kol ze hu ani levaddi, hu hagguf im nefesh hachiyyunit shebbo, aval mikkol makom, yesh bekirbi "chelek Adonai" mammash, sheyyeshno afilu bekal shebbekallim, shehi nefesh haelohit im nitzotz elokut mammash hamelubbash bah lehachayotah, rak shehi bivchinat galut, veim ken, adderabba, kol ma sheani betachlit harichuk meAdonai vehattiuv veshikkutz hare nefesh haelohit shebbi begalut gadol yoter, veharachamanut aleha gedola meod, velaze asim kol megammati vecheftzi – lehotziah ulehaalotah miggalut ze, lahashivah el bet aviha kinureha, kodem shennitlabbesha begufi, shehayta nichlelet beoro yitbarech umeyuchedet immo betachlit, vegam atta ken – tehe kelula umeyuchedet bo yitbarech, kesheasim kol megammati betora umitzvot, lehalebish bahen kol eser bechinoteha kannizkar leel, uvifrat bemitzvat tefilla, litzok el Adonai batztzar lah miggalutah begufi hameshukkatz, lehotziah mimmasger, uledavka bo yitbarech".
Vezo hi bechinat "teshuva umaasim tovim", shehen maasim tovim sheose kede lehashiv "chelek Adonai" limkora vesharsha dechol almin.

Vezot tihye avodato kol yamav besimcha rabba, hi simchat hannefesh betzetah mehagguf hametoav, "veshava el bet aviha kinureha", bishat hattora vehaavoda, uchemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: lihyot kol yamav bitshuva.
Veen lecha simcha gedola ketzet mehaggalut vehashshivya, kimshal ben melech shehaya beshivya vetochen bevet haasurim umenuvvavl beashpa, veyatza lachafshi – el bet aviv hammelech.

Veaf shehagguf omed beshikkutzo vetiuvo, uchemo shekkatuv bazzohar denikra "mashka dechivya", ki mahutah veatzmutah shel hannefesh habbahamit lo nehpach letov likkalel bikdushsha, mikkol makom, tikar nafsho beenav – lismoach besimchatah yoter mehagguf hannivze, shello learbev ulevalbel simchat hannefesh beitztzevon hagguf.

Vehinne, bechina zo hi bechinat yetziat mitzrayim, shenneemar bah: "ki varach haam", delichora hu tamuah, lamma hayta kazot? vechi illu amru lefaro leshallecham chafshi leolam, lo haya mucherach leshallecham?

Ella, mippene shehara shebbenafshot yisrael adayin haya betakpo bechalal hassemali, ki lo faska zuhamatam ad mattan tora, rak megammatam vecheftzam hayta letzet nafsham haelohit miggalut hassitra ochora, hi tumeat mitzrayim, uledavka bo yitbarech, uchedichtiv: "Adonai uzzi umauzzi umenusi beyom tzara vegomer", "misgabbi umenusi vegomer", "vehu manos li vegomer".
Velachen, leatid, kesheyyaavir Adonai ruach hattumea min haaretz, ketiv: "uvimnusa lo telechun, ki holech lifnechem Adonai vegomer".

Velihyot bechinat teshuva zo beyeter seet veyeter oz meumeka delibba, vegam simchat hannefesh tihye betosefet ora vesimcha – kaasher yashiv el libbo daat utevuna lenachamo meitztzevono vigono, lemor kannizkar leel: "hen emet kulei", "ach ani lo asiti et atzmi. velamma asa Adonai kazot, lehorid chelek meoro yitbarech, hamemalle vesovev kol almin vechulla kammeh kela chashiv, vehilbisho bemashka dechivya" vetippa serucha"? en ze, ki im yerida zo – hi tzorech aliyya, lehaalot laAdonai kol nefesh hachiyyunit habbahamit shemmikkelippat noga vechol levusheha, hen bechinot machashava dibbur umaase shellah, al yede hitlabbeshutan bemaase dibbur umachashevet hattora [uchemo sheyyitbaer lekamman inyan haalaa zo baarichut, ech shehi tachlit beriat haolam], veim ken efo, zot eese vezot tihye kol megammati kol yeme cheldi – lechol bahen chayye ruchi venafshi, uchemo shekkatuv: "elecha Adonai nafshi essa", dehayynu, lekashsher machashavti vedibburi – bemachashavto vedibburo yitbarech, vehen hen gufe halachot haaruchot lefanenu, vechen maase – bemaase hammitzvot.
Shellachen nikret hattora "meshivat nafesh", perush – limkorah vesharshah, veal ze neemar: "pikkude Adonai yesharim mesammeche lev":
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 32: Vehinne, al yede kiyyum haddevarim hannizkarim leel, lihyot gufo nivze venimas beenav, rak simchato tihye simchat hannefesh levaddah, hare zo derech yeshara vekalla lavo lide kiyyum mitzvat "veahavta lereacha kamocha" lechol nefesh miyyisrael – lemiggadol vead katan.

Ki meachar sheggufo nimas umetoav etzlo, vehannefesh veharuach mi yodea gedullatan umaalatan besharshan umekoran belokim chayyim. besheggam shekkullan matimot, veav echad lechullana, velachen nikreu kol yisrael "achim" mammash, mitztzad shoresh nafsham baAdonai echad rak shehaggufim mechullakim. velachen, haosim gufam ikkar venafsham tefela – i efshar lihyot ahava veachava amittit benehem, ella hatteluya vedavar levaddah.

Vezehu sheamar hillel hazzaken al kiyyum mitzva zo: "zehu kol hattora chullah, veidach perusha hu kulei". ki yesod veshoresh kol hattora – hu lehagebiah ulehaalot hannefesh al hagguf mala mala ad ikkara vesharsha dechol almin vegam, lehameshich or-en-sof baruch-hu bichneset yisrael, kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman, dehayynu, bimkor nishmot kol yisrael, lemeheve echad beechad davka, velo kesheyyesh perud chas veshalom banneshamot, dekudesha-berich-hu la sharya baatar pegim", uchemo sheomrim: "barchenu avinu kullanu keechad beor panecha", uchemo shennitbaer bemakom acher baarichut:

Uma shekkatuv baggemara, shemmi sheroe bachavero shechata – mitzva lisnovto, vegam lomar lerabbo sheyyisnaehu. hayeynu – bachavero betora umitzvot, uchevar kiyyem bo mitzvat "hocheach tochiach et amitecha" – am sheittecha betora uvemitzvot, veaf-al-pi-chen lo shav mecheto, kemo shekkatuv besefer charedim.

Aval mi sheeno chavero veeno mekorav etzlo, hinne al ze amar hillel hazzaken: "heve mittalmidav shel aharon, ohev shalom vechulei, ohev et habberiyyot umekarvan lattora". lomar, sheaf harchokim mittorat Adonai vaavodato, velachen nikraim beshem "beriyyot" bealma – tzarich lemashchan bechavle avotot ahava, vechulle hay veulay yuchal lekarvan letora vaavodat Adonai; vehen la – lo hifsid sechar mitzvat ahavat reim.

Vegam hamekoravim elav vehochicham velo shavu meavonotehem shemmitzva lisnovtam – mitzva leohovam gam ken. ushetehen hen emet: sina – mitztzad hara shebbahem, veahava – mitztzad bechinat hattov hagganuz shebbahem, shehu nitzotz elokut shebbetocham hamechayye nafsham haelokit. vegam, leorer rachamim belibbo aleha, ki hi bivchinat galut betoch hara missitra ochora haggover aleha barshaim, veharachamanut – mevattelet hassina umeoreret haahava, kannoda mimma shekkatuv: leyaakov asher pada et avraham".
[Velo amar david hammelech alav hashshalom: "tachlit sina senetim vegomer", ella al hamminim vehaeppikorsim, sheen lahem chelek belohe yisrael, kidita baggemara resh perek 16 deshabbat]:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 33: Od zot tihye simchat hannefesh haamittit, uvifrat kesheroe benafsho beittim mezummanim shetztzarich lezakkechah ulehairah besimchat levav, azay yaamik machashavto vitzayyer besichlo uvinato inyan yichudo yitbarech haamitti, ech hu memalle kol almin elyonim vetachtonim, vaafilu melo kol haaretz hallezu hu kevodo yitbarech, vechulla kammeh kela chashiv mammash, vehu levaddo hu baelyonim vetachtonim mammash, kemo shehaya levaddo kodem sheshet yeme vereshit, vegam bammakom hazze shennivra vo olam hazze, hashshamayim vehaaretz vechol tzevaam, haya hu levaddo memalle hammakom hazze, vegam atta ken, hu levaddo beli shum shinnuy kelal.

Mippene shekkol hannivraim betelim etzlo bimtziut mammash, kevittul otiyyot haddibbur vehammachashava bimkoran vesharshan, hu mahut hannefesh veatzmutah, shehen eser bechinoteha: chachma bina vadaat kulei, sheen bahem bechinat otiyyot adayin kodem shemmitlabbeshot bilvush hammachashava [kemo shennitbaer bifrakim 20 vech baarichut, ayyen sham]. uchemo shennitbaer gam ken bemakom acher mashal gashmi laze, meinyan bittul ziv veor hashshemesh bimkoro, hu guf kaddur hashshemesh shebbarakia, sheggam sham meir umitpashshet vadday zivo veoro, uveyeter seet mehitpashshetuto vehearato bachalal haolam, ella sheshsham hu batel bimtziut bimkoro ucheillu eno bimtziut kelal:
Vechacha mammash, derech mashal, hu bittul haolam umeloo bimtziut legabbe mekvro shehu or-en-sof baruch-hu, uchemo shennitbaer sham baarichut.

Vehinne, kesheyyaamik baze harebe, yismach libbo vetagel nafsho af gilat verannen bechol lev venefesh umeod beemuna zo, ki rabba hi, ki hi kirvat elohim mammash. veze kol haadam vetachlit beriato, uveriat kol haolamot elyonim vetachtonim – lihyot lo dira zo battachtonim, kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman baarichut.

Vehinne, kamma gedola simchat hedyot ushefal anashim, behitkarvuto lemelech basar vadam hammitachsen vedar itto immo beveto, vekal vachomer leen ketz lekirvat vedirat melech malche hammelachim hakkadosh-baruch-hu, uchedichtiv: "ki mi hu ze asher arav libbo lageshet elay, neum Adonai":

Veal ze tikkenu litten shevach vehodaya lishmo yitbarech bechol boker, velomar: "ashrenu ma tov chelkenu vechulei uma yafa yerushshatenu", kelomar, kemo shehaadam sas vesameach birushsha shennafla lo hon atek shello amal bo, ken veyoter mikken leen ketz, yesh lanu lismoach al yerushshatenu shehinchilunu avotenu, hu yichud Adonai haamitti, asher afilu baaretz mittachat – en od millevaddo, vezo hi dirato battachtonim.

Vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: taryag mitzvot nittenu leyisrael, ba chavakkuk veheemidan al achat, shenneemar: "vetzaddik beemunato yichye", kelomar, keillu enah rak mitzva achat, hi haemuna levaddah, ki al yede haemuna levaddah – yavo lekiyyum kol hattaryag mitzvot.

Dehayynu, kesheyyihye libbo sas vesameach beemunato beyichud Adonai betachlit hassimcha, keillu lo hayta alav rak mitzva zo levaddah, vehi levaddah tachlit beriato uveriat kol haolamot – hare bechoach vechayyut nafsho besimcha rabba zo, titalle nafsho lemala mala, al kol hammonim kiyyum kol hattaryag mitzvot mibbayit umichutz.

Vezehu sheamar "beemunato yichye" – "yichye" dayyka, kitchiyyayt hammetim, derech mashal, kach tichye nafsho besimcha rabba zo. vehi simcha kefula umechuppelet, ki millevad simchat hannefesh hammaskelet bekirvat Adonai vedirato itto immo. od zot yismach bechiflayim besimchat Adonai vegodel nachat ruach lefanav yitbarech beemuna zo, deitkafya sitra ochora mammash veithappech chashocha linhora, shehu choshech hakkelippot shebbaolam hazze hachumeri hammachashichim umechassim al oro yitbarech ad et ketz, kemo shekkatuv: "ketz sam lachoshech" [dehayynu, "ketz hayyamin", sheyyaavir ruach hattumea min haaretz, "venigla kevod Adonai, verau chol basar yachdav", uchemo sheyyitbaer lekamman].
Uvifrat bechutz laaretz, sheavir eretz haammim tame umale kelippot vesitra ochora, veen simcha lefanav yitbarech keora vesimcha beyitron or habba min hachoshech dayyka.

Vezehu shekkatuv: "yismach yisrael beosav", perush, shekkol mi shehu mizzera yisrael – yesh lo lismoach besimchat Adonai, asher sas vesameach bedirato battachtonim, shehem bechinat asiyya gashmiyyit mammash.

Vezehu shekkatuv "beosav" – leshon rabbim, shehu olam hazze haggashmi hammale kelippot vesitra ochora, shennikra "reshut harabbim" veture difruda", veithappechan linhora, venaasim "reshut hayyachid" leyichudo yitbarech, beemuna zo:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 34: Vehinne, mudaat zot shehaavot hen hen hammerkava", shekkol yemehem leolam, lo hifsiku afilu shaa achat millekashsher datam venishmatam leribbon haolamim – babbittul hannizkar leel leyichudo yitbarech.

Veacharehem kol hanneviim, kol echad lefi madregat nishmato vehassagato, umadregat moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom hi haola al kullana, sheamru alav: "shechina medabberet mittoch gerono shel moshe", umeen ze zachu yisrael bemaamad har sinay, rak shello yachlu lisbol, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha, sheal kol dibbur parcha nishmatan kulei, shehu inyan bittul bimtziut hannizkar leel.
Lachen, miyyad amar lahem laasot lo mishkan uvo kadshe hakkodashim – lehasheraat shechinato, shehu gilluy yichudo yitbarech, kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman.

Umishshecharav bet hammikdash – en lehakkadosh-baruch-hu beolamo mishkan umachon leshivto, hu yichudo yitbarech, ella arba ammot shel halacha, shehu retzono yitbarech vechachmato hamelubbashim bahalachot haaruchot lefanenu. velachen, achar sheyyaamik haadam machashavto beinyan bittul hannizkar leel kefi yechalto, zot yashiv el libbo: "ki mihyot katan sichli veshoresh nishmati mehachil, lihyot merkava umishkan leyichudo yitbarech beemet laamitto, meachar delet machashava dili tefisa umasseget bo yitbarech kelal uchelal shum hassaga baolam, velo shemetz menhu mehassagat haavot vehanneviim, e lazot, eese lo mishkan umachon leshivto, hu haesek betalmud tora kefi happenay shelli, bikviut ittim bayyom uvallayla, kedat hannittena lechol echad veechad behilchot talmud tora, uchemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: 'afilu perek echad shacharit kulei'".

Uvaze yismach libbo veyagil, veyitten hodaa al chelko besimcha uvetuv levav, al shezzacha lihyot ushepzichan laggevura paamayim bechol yom, kefi haet vehappenay shello, kemissat yado asher hirchiv Adonai lo:

Veim yarchiv Adonai lo od, azay "tehor yadayim yosif ometz", umachashava tova kulei", vegam shear hayyom kullo, sheosek bemassa umattan, yihye machon leshivto yitbarech, bintinat hatztzedaka sheyyitten migio, shehi mimmiddotav shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu – "ma hu rachum vechulei", uchemo shekkatuv battikkunim: "chesed deroa yemina".

Veaf sheeno noten ella chomesh, hare hachomesh maale immo kol haarba yadot laAdonai, lihyot machon leshivto yitbarech, kannoda maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha shemmitzvat tzedaka shekula keneged kol hakkarbanot, uvekarbanot haya kol hachay ole laAdonai al yede behema achat, vechol hatztzomeach al yede issaron solet echad balul bashshemen kulei. umillevad ze, hare bishat hattora vehattefilla, ole laAdonai kol ma sheachal veshata venehena mearba hayyadot livriut gufo, kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman.

Vehinne, bechol perate mine simchot hannefesh hannizkarim leel – en mehen menia lihyot "nivze veenav nimas", velev nishbar", veruach nemucha – bishat hassimcha mammash, meachar ki heyoto nivze veenav vechulei – hu mitztzad hagguf venefesh habbahamit, veheyoto besimcha – hu mitztzad nefesh haelohit venitzotz elohut hamelubbash bah lehachayotah, kannizkar leel [beferek 31].
Uchehay gavna ita bazzohar: "bechiyya tekia belibbae missitra da, vechedva tekia belibbae missitra da":
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 35: Vehinne, letosefet beur tevat "laasoto", vegam lehavin meat mizzeer tachlit beriat habbenonim viridat nishmotehem laolam hazze, lehitlabbesh bannefesh habbahamit shemmehakkelippa vesitra ochora, meachar shello yuchelu leshallechah kol yemehem, velidchotah mimmekomah mechalal hassemali shebballev shello yaalu mimmenna hirhurim el hammoach, ki mahutah veatzmutah shel nefesh habbahamit shemmehakkelippa – hi betakpah uvigvuratah etzlam ketoladtah, rak shellevusheha enam mitlabbeshim begufam kannizkar leel, veim ken, lamma ze yardu nishmotehem laolam hazze liga larik chas veshalom, lehillachem kol yemehem im hayyetzer, velo yachlu lo?
Utehi zot nechamatam, lenachamam bechiflayim letushiyya, ulesammeach libbam baAdonai hashshochen ittam betoch toratam vaavodatam.

Vehu, behakedim leshon hayyannuka [bazzohar parashat balak] al pasuk: "hechacham enav berosho" – "vechi bean atar enoy devar nash kulei, ella kera hache hu vadday, ditnan: lo yehach bar nash begilluya deresha arba ammot, may taama, dishchinta sharya al resheh, vechol chacham enohi umilloy beresheh innun, behahu desharya vekayyeyma al resheh, vechad enoy tamman, linda, dehahu nehora deadlik al resheh – itzterich lemishcha, begin degufa devar nash ihu petila, unehora adlik leela, ushelomo malka tzavach veamar: veshemen al roshcha al yechsar, deha nehora divrosho itzterich lemishcha, veinnun ovadan tavan, veal da hechacham enav berosho", ad kan leshono.

Vehinne, beur mashal ze, shehimshil or hashshechina leor hanner sheeno meir veneechaz bappetila beli shemen, vechach en hashshechina shora al guf haadam shennimshal liftila, ella al yede maasim tovim davvka, velo day lo benishmato, shehi chelek eloah mimmaal, lihyot hi keshemen lappetila – mevoar umuvan lechol maskil, ki hinne, nishmat haadam, afilu hu tzaddik gamur oved Adonai beyira veahava betaanugim, af-al-pi-chen, enah betela bimtziut legamre libbatel velikkalel beor Adonai mammash, lihyot laachadim umeyuchadim beyichud gamur, rak hu davar bifne atzmo – yere Adonai veohavo; ma sheen ken hammitzvot umaasim tovim, shehen retzono yitbarech, uretzono yitbarech hu mekor hachayyim lechol haolamot vehabberuim, sheyyored alehem al yede tzimtzumim rabbim vehester panim shel ratzon haelyon baruch-hu viridat hammadregot, ad sheyyuchelu lehithauot ulehibbarot yesh meayin vedavar nifrad bifne atzmo, velo yibbatlu bimtziut kannizkar leel, ma sheen ken hammitzvot, shehen penimit retzono yitbarech, veen sham hester panim kelal – en hachayyut shebbahem davar nifrad bifne atzmo kelal, ella hu meyuchad venichlal birtzono yitbarech, vehayu laachadim mammash beyichud gamur.

Vehinne, inyan hasheraat hashshechina, hu gilluy elohuto yitbarech veor en-sof baruch-hu beeze davar, vehayeynu lomar, sheoto davar nichlal beor Adonai uvatel lo bimtziut legamre, sheaz hu sheshshore umitgalle bo Adonai echad. aval kol ma shello vatel elav bimtziut legamre – en or Adonai shore umitgalle bo. veaf tzaddik gamur shemmitdabbek bo beahava rabba, hare "let machashava tefisa veh" kelal beemet, ki amittat "Adonai elohim emet" – hu yichudo veachduto, shehu levaddo hu veefes bilado mammash.

Veim ken, ze haohev, shehu yesh velo efes – let machashava dileh tefisa veh kelal, veen or Adonai shore umitgalle bo, ella al yede kiyyum hammitzvot, shehen retzono vechachmato yitbarech mammash – beli shum hester panim

Ach kede lehameshich or vehearat hashshechina gam al gufo venafsho habbahamit, shehi hachiyyunit hamelubbeshet begufo mammash, tzarich lekayyem mitzvot maasiyyot hannaasot al yede hagguf mammash, sheaz – koach hagguf mammash shebbaasiyya zo, nichlal beor Adonai uretzono umeyuchad bo beyichud gamur, vehu levush hashshelishi shel nefesh haelohit.

Vaazay, gam koach nefesh hachiyyunit shebbegufo mammash shemmikkelippat noga, nithappech mera letov venichlal mammash bikdushsha kannefesh haelohit mammash, meachar shehu hu happoel veose maase hammitzva, shebbilado, lo hayta nefesh haelohit poelet bagguf kelal, ki hi ruchaniyyit, vehagguf – gashmi vechumeri, vehamemutztza benehem, hi nefesh hachiyyunit habbahamit hamelubbeshet bedam haadam shebbelibbo vechol hagguf.
